Role Summary

Temporal has made a landmark investment as the front-of-shirt sponsor for Crystal Palace FC in the Premier League. This role is for a field marketer and campaign leader first—someone who can turn the sponsorship into a repeatable engine for UK awareness, customer/prospect engagement, and pipeline influence, with a particular focus on getting the right accounts and buying committees “in the seats” through hospitality and integrated field programs.

We’re looking for an experienced field marketer with sports sponsorship and experiential marketing experience, ideally from a larger technical/technology company (or with clearly transferable experience), who understands how to build campaigns that align tightly with Sales priorities and resonate with technical and developer audiences across London and the broader UK market.

Location:

  • London strongly preferred.

  • Candidates based within the United States can also be considered if they have strong connections to the London/UK developer community and are comfortable building local partnerships and delivering in-person activations.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead integrated field marketing plans for the Crystal Palace sponsorship in the UK, translating business goals into campaigns that drive awareness, demand creation, and account engagement.

  • Partner tightly with Sales (most important):

    • Build strong operating rhythms with Sales leadership and account teams (planning, prioritization, follow-up, and measurement).

    • Proactively identify what Sales needs from Marketing to generate engagement and pipeline, and turn that into executable field programs.

    • Design account-driven experiences that help get the right customers and prospects into hospitality moments, events, and matchday experiences (and convert that engagement into next steps).

  • Bring the Crystal Palace sponsorship to life through engaging field marketing experiences:

    • Build a season-long activation approach that supports account engagement, executive relationships, and pipeline influence. We are looking for more than just brand impressions.

    • Develop “in-seat” engagement plays (target account invites, curated hospitality experiences, executive hosting moments, post-match follow-up motions).

  • Grow awareness with technical and developer audiences in the UK:

    • Create/scale programs that build Temporal’s presence with developers and technical communities in London and across the UK.

    • Partner with DevRel and local community leaders (and/or tap existing relationships) to create credible, high-signal experiences.

  • Own the partnership execution with Crystal Palace (secondary to field outcomes):

    • Run operating cadences (weekly check-ins in-season, planning meetings, pre/post-event reviews).

    • Coordinate rights inventory planning and utilization (player/talent access, matchday assets, content moments, community initiatives).

    • Manage approvals, timelines, and deliverables; ensure contractual expectations are met.

  • Coordinate cross-functionally to fully integrate programs (content, PR, paid, lifecycle/email, social, SDR/BDR follow-up, partner channels).

  • Own vendor/agency execution (experiential, production, creative, event partners) with high quality, strong operational rigor, and budget discipline.

  • Measure impact and tell the performance story:

    • Define success metrics (pipeline influence where measurable; directional impact where not).

    • Produce clear recaps and recommendations to improve outcomes throughout the season.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong field marketing and campaign leadership experience, ideally in a technical/technology company, with a track record of delivering integrated programs that support revenue goals.

  • Proven ability to partner with and influence Sales, including comfort aligning priorities, driving joint planning, and building follow-up motions that convert engagement into pipeline.

  • Experience leveraging events, hospitality, and experiential marketing to create meaningful account engagement, attract priority audiences, and inspire continued connection.

  • Experience marketing to technical and developer audiences (developer platforms, infrastructure, tools, or similarly technical products preferred).

  • Sponsorship and experiential experience (sports sponsorship strongly preferred), with comfort managing complex partnerships, rights packages, and high-visibility activations.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership: able to align stakeholders, run tight processes, and execute in fast-moving environments.

  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal): comfortable presenting plans, recaps, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing a major sports sponsorship within a large technology company.

  • DevRel exposure and/or existing connections in the London / UK developer community.

  • Premiere League sponsorship experience (helpful, but should not outweigh field marketing strength, Sales partnership ability, and technical audience experience).

  • Highly organized and outcomes-focused; able to run multiple programs in parallel without losing detail.

  • Collaborative and low-ego; effective at influencing without authority and aligning cross-functional teams.

  • Strong taste and production instincts for high-visibility experiences.

  • Comfortable operating with imperfect attribution and able to define success, learn quickly, and iterate.

Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.

We’re the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe’s top 100 AI startups with a team of 50 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 1M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London.

This is a rare chance to join a rocket ship at exactly the right moment and we’re looking for exceptional people to help us fly it.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the employee lifecycle end-to-end, from offer through to exit and ensuring every stage is handled with care, accuracy, and speed

  • Build and run a best-in-class onboarding experience, managing everything from pre-employment checks and documentation through to day one and beyond

  • Own HR compliance; right-to-work checks, visa sponsorship administration, GDPR, employment law and keep the business clean and audit-ready at all times

  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and produce the reporting the business needs to make good people decisions

  • Be the first point of contact for employee and manager queries, providing clear, confident guidance on policies and processes

  • Continuously improve how we do things, spotting inefficiencies, building better processes, and raising the bar on what great people operations looks like

  • CIPD qualification or equivalent hands-on experience (nice to have)

As a person, you:

  • Take real pride in getting the details right, accuracy and thoroughness aren’t a burden to you, they’re how you work

  • Build trust through consistency and reliability, people know that if you’ve said you’ll do something - it’s done

  • Look for ways to improve processes rather than accepting how things have always been done

  • Are proactive and solutions-focused, you don’t wait to be told something is broken before you fix it

  • Are excited to work in-person from our Paddington, London HQ

  • Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

What does success look like in 6 months?

  • HR operations are running cleanly, records are accurate, compliance is tight, and the team has full confidence in our people processes

  • Onboarding is something new starters genuinely rave about, structured, warm, and seamless from offer to day one

  • You’ve already improved at least two processes and the business feels the difference

As a Senior Backend Engineer within our Maritime domain, you will lead the backend architecture and streaming services that process high-volume vessel tracking, port intelligence, and maritime trade flows. Working with core technologies including Python, PHP, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and ClickHouse, you will design scalable, highly available systems that transform raw maritime telemetry into real-time actionable insights for global shipping and commodity markets. Operating with high autonomy under a "you build it, you run it" engineering culture, you will play a crucial role in modernizing core services, elevating technical standards, and collaborating with cross-functional partners and client-facing technical teams.

  • Architect and scale backend services: Design, build, and maintain high-throughput backend applications and microservices using Python and PHP.

  • Build real-time streaming & analytical pipelines: Leverage Kafka and ClickHouse to stream, process, and analyze massive volumes of real-time maritime tracking data.

  • Optimize data persistence and storage: Manage relational and analytical databases, optimizing PostgreSQL queries and ClickHouse schema designs for low-latency queries at scale.

  • Own production health and reliability: Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and observability frameworks while maintaining operational ownership across staging and production environments.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Tech Leads, Cloud Platform teams, and client-facing technical teams to deliver features aligned with customer needs.

  • Elevate engineering standards and mentorship: Guide peer engineers through technical design reviews, code quality benchmarks, and architectural best practices within the Maritime domain.


Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • Senior-level backend experience: ~5+ years of professional software engineering experience developing, scaling, and maintaining complex production backend systems.

  • Core tech stack mastery: Strong proficiency in Python and PHP alongside deep experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL.

  • Event streaming & analytical data tech: Hands-on production experience with Apache Kafka and high-performance analytical data stores like ClickHouse.

  • System design & API development: Proven track record designing RESTful APIs, distributed microservices, and high-concurrency architecture.

  • Operational mindset: Strong background in CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes), and production observability/monitoring tools.

    • Nice-to-haves

    • Maritime & geospatial domain knowledge: Familiarity with vessel AIS data, geospatial systems, logistics, or global trade datasets.

    • Legacy modernization: Track record of refactoring monolithic architectures into event-driven, decoupled microservices.

title: AI Product Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at paddy
description_html:
Das ist kein gewöhnlicher Job. Wir arbeiten an dem, was unsere Gesellschaft zukunftsfähig macht: Bildung. Dafür bauen wir paddy, das Agentic Operating System für Teaching & Learning.ung.

Unsere Mission ist es, Lehrkräfte zu entlasten, Lernergebnisse zu verbessern und die Unterrichtsqualität zu steigern.

Tausende Lehrkräfte und hunderttausende Lernende nutzen paddy bereits. Mit starken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell. Unsere Ambition ist es, den europäischen AI-Player für Bildung zu bauen.

Als AI Product Engineer übernimmst du Probleme unserer Nutzer End-to-End: vom Verständnis des Problems über Architektur, Backend und Frontend bis zum Deployment. Du prüfst, ob die Lösung im Klassenzimmer wirklich funktioniert. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf AI Engineering: Du baust die agentischen Systeme, die paddy ausmachen, und bringst sie zuverlässig, schnell und bezahlbar in Production.

Aufgaben

  • Product Engineering Erfahrung: Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb moderner Webanwendungen mit TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js und React, in einem Produktteam mit echten Nutzer.
  • AI Engineering Know-how: Du hast LLM-basierte Features oder agentische Systeme gebaut und in Production betrieben. Du verstehst Context Windows, Failure Modes von Modellen, RAG, Vektor-Datenbanken und warum Prompts ohne Evals nicht fertig sind. Kein ML Research nötig, aber echtes technisches Verständnis statt Feature-Ebene.
  • Technisches Fundament: Du bist sicher in API-Design, Datenbanken (SQL, NoSQL und Vector), Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) und CI/CD. Dein stärkster Schwerpunkt darf Backend und Architektur sein, aber du bist kein enger Spezialist.
  • Ownership und Urteilskraft: Du kommst mit unterspezifizierten Problemen klar, findest einfache Lösungen für komplexe Fragen und baust Systeme, die auch im Schulalltag funktionieren.
  • AI-native Arbeitsweise: Du nutzt Coding Agents und moderne AI-Tools selbstverständlich, um deinen Output zu vervielfachen, und beschäftigst dich intensiv damit, wie AI Softwareentwicklung verändert.
  • Sprachen: Fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.

Qualifikation

  • Sichtbaren Impact: Du arbeitest am wichtigsten Zukunftsthema unserer Gesellschaft, der Bildung.
  • 70.000 bis 100.000 € Bruttojahresgehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung, plus Equity (VSOP).
  • 100 % Remote-Arbeit. Wenn du lieber ins Büro kommst, steht dir unser modernes Office in Bielefeld offen.
  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum und Ownership sowie direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern und einem starken Product- und Engineering-Team.
  • Ein hohes Budget, solange der Nutzen stimmt.
  • Zeit und Unterstützung für deine Entwicklung, mit Fortbildungsbudget, Coaching und klaren Entwicklungsperspektiven.
  • 30 Urlaubstage und 50 € monatlichen steuerfreien Sachbezug.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und Offsites.
  • Starkes Backing durch erfahrene Investoren und Mentoren.

Benefits

  • Brutaler Impact: Du arbeitest an dem wichtigsten gesellschaftlichen Thema überhaupt: Bildung.
  • 70.000 bis 100.000 € Brutto-Jahresgehalt, abhängig von Erfahrung, plus Equity (VSOP)
  • 100 % Remote: Wenn du lieber vor Ort arbeitest, steht dir unser modernes Office in Bielefeld offen
  • Nahezu unbegrenztes Budget, solange der ROI stimmt
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern und einem starken Product-&-Engineering-Team
  • Sehr viel Gestaltungsspielraum & full Ownership
  • Weiterentwicklung & Lernen: Budget für Fortbildungen, Zugang zu Coaching und klare Entwicklungsperspektiven
  • 30 Urlaubstage, 50 € monatlicher steuerfreier Sachbezug
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und Offsites
  • Starkes Backing: Top-Investoren und Mentoren

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wenn die Kalender passen, können wir den gesamten Prozess innerhalb von fünf Tagen abschließen.

  1. Kennenlernen, Tag 1: Im ersten Gespräch schauen wir, ob es für beide Seiten passt. Wenn ja, vereinbaren wir direkt deinen Probetag.
  2. Probetag mit Case Study, Tag 4: Du arbeitest mit uns an einer echten Aufgabe und stellst anschließend dein Ergebnis vor.
  3. Gespräch mit unserem CEO, Tag 4: Das Gespräch findet am Abend deines Probetags statt.
  4. Teamgespräch, Tag 5: Du lernst die Engineers kennen, mit denen du arbeiten wirst.
  5. Entscheidung, Tag 5: Nach dem Teamgespräch geben wir dir unsere finale Rückmeldung.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Erzähl uns, welche Probleme du gelöst, welche Entscheidungen du getroffen und welche Systeme du in Produktion gebracht hast.

title: Teilzeitkraft Küche (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Munich Electrification
description_html:
About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

Über Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification ist ein innovatives Unternehmen, das mit dem Ziel gegründet wurde, den Übergang zur elektrischen und vernetzten Mobilität zu beschleunigen. Wir entwickeln innovative elektronische Steuergeräte für Elektrofahrzeuge und stationäre Speichersysteme für unsere Kunden weltweit. Unser internationales Team setzt sich aus hochmotivierten und exzellenten Ingenieur: innen zusammen. Als kleines und spezialisiertes Team sind wir uns der Bedeutung jedes/r einzelnen Kolleg: in bewusst und fördern jede/n Mitarbeiter/in nach ihren Fähigkeiten und Bedürfnissen. Unser Büro mit angeschlossenem Prototypen- und Testlabor befindet sich im Herzen von München am Heimeranplatz.

 

Das ist es, wofür wir stehen:

– Technologische Führerschaft: Wir stellen Normen infrage, sind innovativ und antizipieren zukünftige Bedürfnisse. Wir gehen bewusst Risiken ein, lernen aus den Ergebnissen und sind so immer einen Schritt voraus.

– Nachhaltigkeit: Wir treiben aktiv den Wandel für eine nachhaltige Zukunft voran, sind uns unserer Auswirkungen bewusst und inspirieren andere, eine bessere Welt zu schaffen.

- Teamkultur: Wir glauben, dass Arbeit Spaß machen sollte, und fördern einen Geist der Inspiration, des Feierns und der Teamarbeit auf der ganzen Welt.

- Unternehmerischer Geist: Wir sind offen für Veränderungen, denken in großen Dimensionen und gehen mit Leidenschaft an unsere Grenzen.

 

Erfahre mehr über uns auf unserer Website.

 

Deine Rolle

Wir sind ein junges Münchner Unternehmen in der Nähe vom Westpark und essen mittags am liebsten gemeinsam ein frisch zubereitetes, vegetarisches Essen in entspannter Runde. Deshalb suchen wir ab sofort eine motivierte Person, die uns als Teilzeitkraft für 20-30h/Woche in der Küche unterstützt - idealerweise von Montag bis Freitag, bis Donnerstag ist aber auch völlig in Ordnung! Gerne bringst du bereits Küchenerfahrung mit und/oder bist ein/e ambitionierte/r Hobbykoch/-Köchin. Gekocht wird bei uns für ca. 150-200 Personen. Wir haben eine top ausgestattete Küche, einen tolles Küchenteam inkl. Küchenchef, die sich über deine Unterstützung sehr freuen werden. Du unterstützt unseren Chef de Cuisine bei der Essensplanung und die Kolleginnen beim Vorbereiten, Schibbeln, Kochen, Reinigen etc., damit es bei uns Montag bis Freitag leckeres, frisch gekochtes und gesundes Essen für unsere Mitarbeiter gibt. Du bringst das Essen mit unserem Firmenwagen zu unserem zweiten Standort, der nur wenige Minuten entfernt liegt. Anschließend reinigst du den Küchenbereich verantwortungsbewusst und bringst die genutzten Utensilien zurück in unsere Hauptküche an unserem Hauptsitz.

Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben

  • Du hilfst bei der Zubereitung von vegetarischem Essen.

  • Du beteiligst dich bei der wöchentlichen Essensplanung.

  • Du reinigst anschließend gemeinsam mit dem Team den Küchenbereich verantwortungsbewusst.

  • Du arbeitest in einer Teilzeitstelle (20 bis 30 Std./Woche) bei uns an fünf Tagen/Woche von ca. 10.00 -14.00 Uhr (wird nach Absprache mit dir flexibel gehandhabt).

Das bringst du mit

  • Vergleichbare Gastronomieausbildung oder Erfahrung in der Küche notwendig

  • Hohe Motivation, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Zuverlässigkeit

  • Kreativität, Begeisterung und Enthusiasmus für die Arbeit in der Küche

  • Sinn für Hygiene und Sauberkeit

  • Eigenständiges Arbeiten

  • Teamfähigkeit

  • Kommunikativ, hilfsbereit und freundlich im Umgang, gute Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse

  • Führerscheinklasse B

Was wir dir bieten

Du hast die Chance, Teil eines hochinnovativen, agilen und einzigartigen Teams zu sein, das mit den renommiertesten Kunden im Automobilsektor zusammenarbeitet. Außerdem kannst du deine Kenntnisse im Bereich der Batterien für vernetzte und elektrische Fahrzeuge, Batteriemanagement und Elektronikentwicklung vertiefen. Das Ganze in einem spannenden Arbeitsumfeld mit verschiedenen inspirierenden Teamevents. Dich erwartet eine angemessene und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung, flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein gesundes Mittagessen, sowie täglich frische Snacks.

Our Offer & Benefits

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector. You will gain a deeper knowledge around connected & electric vehicle batteries, battery management and electronics development and strive in an exciting work environment

Benefits (Full-time Employees):

- Trust-based working hours and hybrid work

- Adequate and competitive compensation

- Pension Plan/Bonus

- Free access to the fitness center right next to us or subsidized EGYM Wellpass

- Free snacks, coffee, drinks and lunch (freshly cooked by our chef) every day

- Public transport ticket

- Bike-Leasing via Business Bike

- Experience various inspiring and fun team events

- ME-branded clothing

- Option to "work from anywhere" (6 weeks/year)

title: Staff Data Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Jupus
description_html:
We're seeking a Staff Data Engineer to join one of the fastest-growing AI legal tech companies in Europe. You'll take technical ownership of the data platform behind how we run the business: the pipelines, the warehouse, and the definitions behind the numbers our leadership team actually uses.

You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work alongside a colleague who owns the business-facing side of data, plus our infrastructure and application engineers. This is a senior individual contributor role with no line management in either direction, roughly 70% hands-on building, 30% defining, documenting and explaining.

Your Challenge and Opportunity in This Role

JUPUS supports hundreds of law firms across Europe, and our customer base is growing roughly 4x a year. Our data platform has grown with it (ClickHouse, dbt, Python extract-load pipelines into an S3 data lake, orchestration in GitHub Actions) and it has grown fast.

Your job is to make it trustworthy. That means modernising what already exists, making historical trends a record of what actually happened rather than a nightly re-derivation of it, and owning the definitions behind the metrics that reach our board. This is not a greenfield build, and it is not a maintenance seat. It is a real platform with real problems, and you would own it.

Tasks

  • Own the data platform end to end: ingestion and the raw layer, the ClickHouse warehouse, and the dbt project on top of it. You're the person who can say whether a number is wrong or the pipeline is.

  • Make our numbers trustworthy: reliability, correctness, and a history that holds up, so that a trend is a record of what actually happened rather than a re-derivation of it.

  • Own the metrics the company runs on, starting with our customer health score- the definition, the denominator, the eligibility rules and the known limitations, not just the SQL underneath them.

  • Turn business questions into durable metrics: work directly with Customer Success, Sales, Product and leadership to understand what they're actually trying to decide, then build something defensible enough to decide on.

  • Keep cost and complexity in check as we grow: warehouse architecture, query cost, and the surfaces that deliver data into BI and our CRM. All of it gets harder as the customer base multiplies.

  • Set the standard for how data work is done here: one authoritative written definition per leadership-visible number, and the conventions that inform our Data function as it grows with us.

Requirements

Technical Expertise

  • Substantial experience in data engineering or analytics engineering, with production ownership of a warehouse and a transformation layer. We care more about evidence of ownership than about years served.

  • ClickHouse in production.

  • dbt at ownership level: incremental models, snapshots, tests, macros, CI/CD. Ideally you've inherited someone else's dbt project and left it better than you found it.

  • Python data engineering: EL tooling, S3, CI-based orchestration that you’ve owned end to end, with no platform team behind you.

  • Product event streams: PostHog, Amplitude, Segment, Mixpanel or similar. You understand how user-to-company identity and group association break, and what that does to every metric downstream.

Judgement and Ownership

  • You have defined a business KPI end to end and defended it to non-technical people. This is the differentiator for us. An excellent engineer who takes requirements as given is not the right fit for this role.

  • Analytical rigour: cohorts, correct denominators, sample size stated before findings. You'll say "we can't tell yet, and here's exactly why" rather than produce a confident chart.

  • You act without waiting for a ticket, and you can name something you chose to stop doing.

  • You're comfortable in front of senior stakeholders, including C-level, and can hold a technical line without losing the room.

Further Requirements

  • Located within CET +/-2.

  • Nice to have: BI tool administration (we use Metabase), CRM and billing systems as data sources, dlt specifically, GDPR-driven data deletion work, Grafana, German, or B2B SaaS and legal-tech domain experience.

  • Nice to have: you're used to non-technical colleagues querying data through AI tools, and you design for that.

Benefits

🎯 Metric Ownership – Own a business-critical metric end to end, definition included — not just the pipeline that feeds it.

🛠️ A Real Platform – ClickHouse and dbt already in production, with genuine problems worth solving. No greenfield theatre, no maintenance seat.

⚡ Direct Access – A flat structure and a direct line to our Head of Engineering, CTO and CEO. No committee between you and a decision.

📈 Growth Stage – Roughly 4x customer growth a year at one of Europe's fastest-growing AI legal tech companies.

🏡 Fully Remote – Enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere

💻 Top Equipment – State-of-the-art MacBook plus all the accessories you need

🏋️ Wellbeing Perks – Urban Sports Club membership to support your healthy lifestyle

If you're excited about owning the numbers an AI startup runs on and delivering the data that guides us in our scaling journey, we'd love to hear from you.

description_html:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. title: Commercial Analyst, DACH
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Heidi
description_html:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We are looking for an enthusiastic, driven, and proactive commercial analyst to join our expanding DACH go-to-market team. As a key member of our commercial team, you will play a crucial role in sourcing and qualifying leads, initiating outreach, and scheduling high-value conversations for our Account Executives. Your goal will be to create meaningful connections with healthcare practices and hospital groups, facilitating our mission to win across the DACH market.

This role requires a proactive mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a high-growth startup environment. You will become an expert in engaging healthcare stakeholders, driving new opportunities, and contributing directly to the sales pipeline.

What you’ll do

  • Identify, research, and prospect potential customers and formulate go-to-market strategies

  • Execute inbound and outbound campaigns using a mix of calls, emails, social selling, and product-led signals to qualify leads.

  • Schedule high-quality meetings and product demonstrations for Account Executives, ensuring smooth handoff of qualified opportunities.

  • Own and manage end-to-end sales cycles for small SMB customers, from initial outreach through to closing deals.

  • Maintain accurate records in HubSpot CRM, manage and optimise sales pipelines, and consistently meet targets for qualified leads generated.

  • Collaborate closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Product, Operations, and Customer Success teams to streamline sales strategies and market positioning.

  • Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and evolving customer needs to identify new opportunities.

What we're looking for

  • 1-2 years of experience in sales or in tech, banking, consulting, PE/VC or similar.

  • Proven success in generating leads, qualifying prospects, and managing high-volume outreach campaigns.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, able to quickly build rapport and articulate the value of Heidi’s AI-driven healthcare solutions.

  • Highly organised, disciplined, and results-oriented with a strong problem-solving ability and the ability to prioritise multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Comfortable working independently in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment with a high degree of accountability.

  • Eager to learn, adaptable, and excited about professional growth opportunities.

Attitude is more important than experience so if you are a hungry, competitive and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem solving and building relationships we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.


We take care of you.
We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

title: Head of Product - Clients (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Upvest
description_html:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

As Upvest continues to scale, we are looking for an exceptional Head of Product - Clients. You will work closely with Florian Thiel, Christian Wöhlke, and the Product & Engineering teams of the tribe (3 domain teams in total). In addition you will need to build strong relations with the Operations, Banking and Commercial leadership teams, owning topics critical to Upvest's product and business success.

Lead the clients tribe's product vision and strategy:

As Head of Product, you start leading one of the Clients tribe teams directly, while guiding the overarching strategy and success of the Clients Tribe and you start scaling yourself. You will work very closely with the Director of Engineering and VP of Product to define the tribe's strategy, set OKRs, and shape the long-term roadmap. The goal: to power Upvest's asymmetric scaling by building the intelligent, seamless "AI-experience", internal and external, that makes flawless API experiences the foundation of Upvest's ecosystem.

Drive asymmetric scaling through intelligent, agentic operations:

Your challenge is to make our tools and workflows scale without lockstep headcount growth.. That means embedding intelligence and automation into every process, and exploring how agentic operations, AI agents handling operational workflows end to end, can take on work that today needs manual effort. You'll be the go-to voice for applied AI across our tooling, helping the business run efficiently and helping clients get to market faster, at lower cost and higher reliability.

Take tooling into its next stage:

You'll own the roadmap for Internal Tooling or Upfront, both key strategic product enablers for scaling the business, and drive it forward through OKRs, deciding where to push deeper automation, broaden coverage, or reimagine a workflow entirely. You'll work directly with the Engineering team, and stay close to the people the products serve, so every step forward is one that truly matters.


What you’ll do:

  • Significant impact and strategic influence, shaping the roadmap and scaling strategy with a seat at the table with engineering and product leadership.

  • Autonomy coupled with inspirational leadership. You fully own the product success of your team and function.

  • Product-centricity throughout the organisation, with no struggle for relevance that product people may encounter elsewhere.

  • Product Engineering culture, working closely with engineering counterparts guided by joint OKRs and a clear roadmap.

  • An exceptional team, combining impactful work with a relaxed, fun atmosphere and consistently high eNPS.

  • Continuous learning across investments, API products, and a state-of-the-art tech stack.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years in Product Management, ideally with a focus on internal and/or external tooling. Financial services, compliance, or fintech experience is a big plus.

  • Proven people leadership of teams of 3+ people.

  • Firm grasp of UI/UX best practices; can ideate and prototype through lo-fi wireframes and collaborate closely with design.

  • Strong track record of taking initiative, owning outcomes, and bridging dependencies.

  • Be a sponge. You don't need to be a finance or investment expert, but you'll need to absorb complex topics quickly (subledger reconciliation, mutual fund trading flow) and apply strong product fundamentals.

  • Experience with agile software development, delivering features and outcomes consistently.

  • Comfortable with product toolkits such as Linear, Slite, Miro, and Figma.

  • Familiarity with API documentation standards and an interest in how AI agents consume APIs (MCP or similar) is a strong plus.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description_html:
Technical Program Manager, Go

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

Superhuman is building the AI-native future of work: a family of products people and companies rely on to think, write, and get things done faster, and we're looking for a Technical Program Manager to help shape what Superhuman Go becomes. You'd be joining a team that's rethinking what proactive AI can look like in practice. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and product management teams, shipping software that meaningfully anticipates and amplifies human productivity at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive engineering delivery end-to-end. You'll support the program management of multi-quarter engineering initiatives from planning through launch. That means working closely with engineering teams to track milestones, surface dependencies, and manage technical risks as they come up.

  • Translate engineering requirements into plans people can actually execute. You'll partner with engineering leads to break down technical work into phased delivery plans with clear milestones — identifying the critical path, spotting dependencies, and flagging resource constraints before they become problems. The goal is to give teams the clarity they need to make confident, autonomous decisions.

  • Get into the technical detail. You'll engage directly with engineers on architecture decisions, trade-offs, and system design. You do need to understand what's being built and why, so you can help the team make smart calls about scope, quality, and when something is ready to ship.

  • Track and improve engineering health. You'll keep an eye on delivery metrics, flag risks early, and run post-launch retrospectives to capture what you've learned. You'll work with engineering and data teams to establish the signals that tell you whether a system is doing what it should — and act quickly when it isn't.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in a fast-scaling tech environment. You're either coming from a technical background (Software Engineering, , QA, Data Engineering, or similar) and stepping into program management, or you've been a Program Manager before and want to go deeper on the engineering side.

  • Enough technical depth to earn engineering trust. You understand how software systems are built — whether from hands-on experience writing code, working in data infrastructure, or spending real time embedded with engineering teams.

  • Strong programme management fundamentals, or the drive to build them. You understand (or are genuinely eager to learn) how to run a delivery cadence: planning cycles, dependency tracking, risk management, and keeping stakeholders in the loop. If you're coming from a pure engineering background, you're coachable and excited to develop this side of your skillset.

  • You're proactive and organized. You don't wait to be told what needs to be done — you gather context, spot gaps, and get moving. You can hold multiple engineering workstreams in your head at once without losing sight of what matters most.

  • You build real credibility with engineers. Whether through a shared technical background or genuine curiosity about how things work, you earn trust with engineering teams, not by managing them from above, but by making their work easier and their path to delivery clearer.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and move with purpose. Shifting priorities don't throw you off — you adapt quickly and stay focused. You know when to push forward and when to slow down and get the right alignment before committing a team to a direction.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional Growth: We believe autonomy and trust are what allow people to do their best, most innovative work — in a way that plays to their strengths and fits their life.

  • A connected team: We build a product that helps people connect, and we try to live that in how we work together too. Our remote-first, hybrid model supports a genuinely collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work hard to foster a sense of belonging — through Superhuman Circles (our team member resource groups for people with shared identities, including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents), and through programmes that celebrate our colleagues and the things we achieve together.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: We offer competitive pay alongside a benefits package that covers life care (including mental health support and risk benefits), generous and clearly defined time off, home office setup support, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: We'll help make your move to Berlin as smooth as possible. Our relocation package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in, and a relocation bonus to cover things like temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all — especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech — to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, colour, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

The Opportunity

As a Systems Engineer on Superhuman's Corporate Infrastructure team, you will design and lead the automation, security, and scalability of our company’s identity and endpoint management platforms. You’ll help architect, implement, and evolve the core systems responsible for identity lifecycle, secure device posture, automation, and compliance—foundations that empower every Superhuman employee to work securely and efficiently at scale.

Unlike traditional Help Desk roles, this is a high-impact, engineering-focused position dedicated to building and automating the underlying platforms and tools for identity & access management and device fleet operations. Your work will span areas such as endpoint provisioning, zero-touch deployment, compliance automation, and security policy enforcement.

You will collaborate closely with other engineers, security, IT, and business partners to deliver systems and self-service capabilities that enable seamless and secure productivity across macOS, Windows, and mobile devices.

In this role, you will

  • Architect and lead the development of scalable systems for identity lifecycle management, device fleet provisioning, compliance hardening, and endpoint automation.

  • Design and implement solutions that ensure identity and device access is secure, manageable, and automated across a rapidly scaling organization.

  • Build automation around Okta, Jamf Pro, Workspace ONE, and underlying platforms using Python, PowerShell, bash, and Git.

  • Lead migration and platform consolidation efforts (e.g., UEM platform moves, IdP cutovers, M&A integrations) to streamline integration and reduce operational complexity.

  • Automate joiner-mover-leaver workflows to automate employee lifecycle workflows.

  • Develop self-service and reliability tooling that reduces manual operational work and empowers end users and internal teams.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (security, IT, engineering, finance) to design access policies, implement compliance controls, and integrate device trust with identity frameworks.

  • Mentor team members, set technical direction, and help define the charter and short- and long-term roadmaps of the Corporate Infrastructure team.

Qualifications

  • Experience architecting and operating large-scale identity and endpoint management solutions across macOS, Windows, and mobile platforms.

  • Expertise in enterprise identity tools (Okta, SSO, SCIM), endpoint management (Jamf, Workspace ONE, Intune), and automation (Python, PowerShell, bash, Git).

  • Proven ability to design and implement device compliance and access security controls (CIS benchmarks, device-trust enforcement, zero-touch deployment).

  • Strong knowledge of IT automation, infrastructure-as-code, and building tooling to streamline onboarding, provisioning, and compliance at scale.

  • Demonstrated record of working with stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.

  • Strategic thinker with experience migrating platforms, merging device fleets, and automating complex workflows.

  • Excellent collaborator and communicator, comfortable working with cross-functional teams and end users.

  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional growth: We hire people we trust, and we give team members autonomy to do their best work. We also support professional development with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. We have a highly collaborative culture. We also take time to celebrate our colleagues ' accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific events and programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package that includes superior health care. We also offer ample and defined time off, catered lunches, gym and recreation stipends, admission discounts, and more.

description_html:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

title: Manager, Data Platform

description_html:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the development and evolution of its shared data platform in a hands-on technical leadership role. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role. You will lead a Berlin-based team, set technical direction, make key architecture decisions, and get directly involved in the hardest platform and reliability problems. The team owns shared data infrastructure and raw data quality foundations, including ingestion, storage, orchestration, runtime, and platform governance. You will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, Operations, Security, and Product partners to build a scalable, trusted, and cost-effective platform for analytics, reporting, experimentation, and machine learning.

This role is required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the roadmap for KAYAK’s shared data platform.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing Berlin-based team of data platform engineers.

  • Evolve the platform architecture across ingestion, storage, orchestration, runtime, and lakehouse foundations.

  • Build core capabilities such as schema registry, data contracts, observability, metadata, and semantic layer implementation.

  • Enforce data retention policies and platform controls for different data types and usage needs.

  • Improve platform reliability by building the tooling and platform capabilities needed for monitoring, alerting, incident response, and operational readiness.

  • Drive platform modernization and simplify legacy systems where it creates clear value.

  • Define clear ownership boundaries so the platform team owns shared infrastructure and raw data quality, while downstream teams own business logic.


Please apply if:

  • You have 8+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, data architecture, or a related role.

  • You have meaningful people-management experience and a high technical bar.

  • You have strong knowledge of large-scale data platform architecture, including streaming, batch, storage, orchestration, and distributed query engines.

  • You have hands-on experience with technologies relevant to KAYAK’s stack, such as Kafka, Flink, Iceberg, Trino, AWS, Kubernetes, Airflow, Python, SQL, and schema-based data contracts.

  • You have led platforms with high-throughput event streams and large-scale analytical data.

  • You have led platform migrations or infrastructure modernization efforts with strong judgment on risk, reliability, cost, and business continuity.

  • You are comfortable working across Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, Operations, Security, and Product on technically complex topics.

  • You bring high ownership, sound judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Public transportation subsidies

  • Bike leasing program

  • Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams

  • An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin

     

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

title: (Junior) Relationship Manager Investments (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Liqid Lam
description_html:
Deine Rolle:

Als (Junior) Relationship Manager Investments (m/w/d) bekommst du die Chance, aktiv zum Erfolg und Wachstum unseres Unternehmens beizutragen und dich in der Betreuung anspruchsvoller und vermögender Kund:innen weiterzuentwickeln. Du bist eine wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen und repräsentierst LIQID im täglichen Austausch. Dein Auftreten, deine Lernbereitschaft sowie deine Serviceorientierung tragen maßgeblich dazu bei, langfristige und vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen.


Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Fokus auf Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen: Du stehst unseren vermögenden Bestandskund:innen bei allen Fragen rund um das Thema Vermögensverwaltung und Marktgeschehen kompetent und verlässlich zur Seite. Dabei baust du aktiv eine Vertrauensbasis zu deiner Kundschaft auf, sicherst die Zufriedenheit und entwickelst Kundenbeziehungen durch deine zielgerichtete und serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Individuelle Lösungen anbieten: Du erkennst die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Kund:innen und begeisterst sie für unsere Anlageprodukte. Gleichzeitig informierst du sie über aktuelle Anlagestrategien und Depotumschichtungen und bringst dein wachsendes Marktverständnis gezielt in die Beratung ein.

  • Teil eines innovativen Teams sein: Du übermittelst nicht nur das Feedback unserer Kund:innen, sondern bringst auch eigene Impulse in die Teams für Sales, Marketing, Operations und Tech ein. So gestaltest du aktiv die externe Kommunikation mit und trägst zur Weiterentwicklung von Produkten und Plattformen im Sinne unseres Klientels bei.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Background: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Berufsausbildung (idealerweise Bankausbildung) oder ein erfolgreich absolviertes Studium (bevorzugt im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen).

  • Skills und Qualifikationen: Du hast bereits erste relevante Berufserfahrung in der Kundenberatung im Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld gesammelt. Dabei konntest du ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Finanzprodukte und verschiedene Anlageklassen entwickeln. Du interessierst dich für globale Kapitalmärkte sowie aktuelle wirtschaftliche und politische Entwicklungen und verfolgst diese regelmäßig. Eine strukturierte, serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude am Umgang mit Kund:innen zeichnen dich aus. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Mindset: Du bist verantwortungsbewusst, zuverlässig und zeichnest dich durch eine ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung aus. Außerdem bist du kommunikationsstark und kannst dich durch private und berufliche Berührungspunkte ausgezeichnet in unsere Zielgruppe hineinversetzen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, setzt die richtigen Prioritäten und begegnest Herausforderungen proaktiv mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität. Du hast keine Schwierigkeiten damit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld Bestleistungen abzurufen.


Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

  • Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

So geht es für dich weiter:

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

  • Erstes Kennenlernen mit unserem Recruiting-Team via Videocall.

  • Videointerview mit deiner zukünftigen Führungskraft: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

  • Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du triffst das Team und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Arbeit eines Relationship Managers.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 3,8 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

title: Office Manager (m/w/d) - mit Perspektive People Operations
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Cosuno
description_html:
Du machst unser Berliner Office zu dem Ort, an dem unser Team gerne arbeitet – und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Aufgaben aus People Operations.

Deine Mission

Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für alles, was unser Office ausmacht: Du sorgst dafür, dass der Laden läuft, Gäste sich willkommen fühlen und niemand im Team überlegen muss, wo der Kaffee, das Paket oder der Meetingraum-Adapter geblieben ist.

Heute wird Office Management nebenbei aus dem People-&-Culture-Team mitgemacht. Dein Job ist es, das zu übernehmen, in klare Prozesse zu bringen – und dabei nach und nach in People-Operations-Themen hineinzuwachsen.

Ehrlich gesagt: Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt im Office Management, etwa 70 % deiner Zeit. Die verbleibenden rund 30 % sind People Ops – mit der Perspektive, diesen Anteil auszubauen, wenn Rolle, Team und Unternehmen mitwachsen.


Deine Aufgaben

Office & Facility (Hauptfokus)

  • Du hältst unser Office in Berlin-Kreuzberg am Laufen: Empfang von Gästen, Post, Lieferungen, Ordnung in Küche, Meetingräumen und gemeinsamen Flächen

  • Du steuerst unsere Dienstleister – Vermieter, Reinigung, Handwerker, Getränke- und Snacklieferanten – und bist deren feste Ansprechperson

  • Du verwaltest Zugänge, Schlüssel und Arbeitsplätze und sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleg:innen ab Tag eins einen fertigen Platz vorfinden

Beschaffung & Budget

  • Du übernimmst das Bestellwesen für Office, Verbrauchsmaterial und Team-Bedarf

  • Du prüfst Rechnungen vor, bereitest sie für unser Finance-Team auf und behältst das Office-Budget im Blick

Events & Team-Erlebnis

  • Du organisierst Team-Events, Offsites, Sommerfest und Weihnachtsfeier – von der Location über das Catering bis zur Logistik

  • Du unterstützt bei der Organisation unserer Onsite Weeks, wenn unsere remote arbeitenden Kolleg:innen nach Berlin kommen

People Operations (dein Wachstumsbereich)

  • Du bereitest Onboardings vor: Welcome-Paket, Arbeitsplatz, Stammdaten in Personio, Koordination des ersten Tages

  • Du pflegst Personalakten und Stammdaten, erstellst Bescheinigungen und steuerst den Rücklauf von Dokumenten

  • Du behältst Zeiterfassung und Abwesenheiten in Personio im Blick und bereitest Zulieferungen für die Gehaltsabrechnung vor

  • Du unterstützt im Recruiting: Interview-Koordination in Ashby, Betreuung von Kandidat:innen vor Ort

  • Du wirkst an People-Projekten mit – von Benefits über unser Mitarbeiterhandbuch bis zu Feedbackzyklen

So arbeiten wir

  • Ownership von Tag eins: Das Office ist deins. Du entscheidest, wie du es organisierst – mit dem Rückhalt unseres People-&-Culture-Teams.

  • Struktur statt Feuerwehr: Uns ist lieber, du löst ein Problem einmal richtig und dokumentierst es, als es zehnmal zu lösen. Einfache, verlässliche Abläufe zu bauen, ist Teil des Jobs.

  • AI als tägliches Werkzeug: Wir nutzen KI-Tools wie Claude unternehmensweit. Ob Textentwurf, Checkliste oder Auswertung – wir erwarten, dass du KI aktiv einsetzt, um schneller und besser zu arbeiten.

  • Wachstum, das zur Rolle passt: Wie schnell der People-Ops-Anteil wächst, hängt davon ab, wie stabil das Office läuft und welche Themen im Team entstehen. Wir sprechen das regelmäßig und offen miteinander durch.

Dein Profil

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du mitbringst:

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Unser Team ist international, unser Alltag zweisprachig.

  • Erste Berufserfahrung im Office Management, in der Assistenz, am Empfang, in der Hotellerie oder im Eventbereich – oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit vergleichbarer Praxis

  • Organisationstalent und Eigenantrieb. Du siehst, was ansteht, bevor jemand dich darauf hinweist, und ziehst Dinge zu Ende.

  • Diskretion. Du arbeitest mit Personaldaten und vertraulichen Informationen und gehst selbstverständlich sorgfältig damit um.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion) und Lust, dich in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten

  • Echtes Interesse an People- und HR-Themen und die Bereitschaft, dir diesen Bereich Schritt für Schritt zu erarbeiten

Pluspunkte für:

  • Erfahrung mit Personio oder einem vergleichbaren HR-System

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit HR-Administration, Recruiting-Koordination oder Payroll-Zuarbeit

  • Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Startup

  • Grundverständnis für Rechnungsprüfung und Budgetkontrolle

  • Erfahrung in der Organisation von Team-Events

Berufseinsteiger:innen sind ausdrücklich willkommen – uns ist wichtiger, wie du arbeitest, als wie lange du es schon tust.


Praktisches

Diese Rolle ist eine Präsenzrolle in unserem Office in der Prinzenstraße 34 in Berlin-Kreuzberg – ein großer Teil der Aufgaben lässt sich nur vor Ort erledigen. Wir erwarten dich an 4–5 Tagen pro Woche im Office und sind bei Arbeitszeiten und einzelnen Remote-Tagen flexibel. Die Stelle ist in Vollzeit ausgeschrieben, ab 32 Stunden möglich.

Gehalt: 40.000 – 45.000 € brutto pro Jahr bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche, bei reduzierter Stundenzahl anteilig.


Warum wir?

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust unser Office Management von Grund auf und prägst, wie unser Team seinen Arbeitsalltag erlebt.

  • Eine klare Perspektive: Ein Einstieg, aus dem sich eine Rolle in People Operations entwickeln kann – mit einer erfahrenen People-&-Culture-Lead als direkter Ansprechpartnerin.

  • Top-Ausstattung: Ein neues MacBook, damit du gutes Werkzeug hast.

  • Ein starkes Team: Regelmäßige Offsites und Team-Events, die uns als Menschen verbinden, nicht nur als Kolleg:innen.

  • Sicherheit: Ein unbefristeter Vertrag in einem stabilen, gut finanzierten Unternehmen.

Über uns

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

Wir sind Cosuno – ein schnell wachsendes Tech-Startup, das die Bauindustrie mit unserer digitalen Plattform für Ausschreibungen und Beschaffungsprozesse effizienter und transparenter macht. Unser Ziel: die komplexesten Herausforderungen der Branche mit Innovation und Einfachheit lösen.

Künstliche Intelligenz ist der Schlüssel unserer Lösung: Sie analysiert Millionen von Preisdatenpunkten und hilft Bauunternehmen, präzise und effiziente Angebote zu erstellen. Das spart unseren Kund:innen Zeit und vermeidet unnötige Kosten.

Aber für uns geht es nicht nur um Technologie – es geht um die Menschen dahinter. Bei Cosuno arbeitest du mit kreativen Köpfen, die die Bauindustrie neu denken. Wir glauben an Vielfalt, weil die besten Ideen aus unterschiedlichen Perspektiven entstehen. Ein integratives und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ist für uns selbstverständlich.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

Compensation: €40K – €45K

  • • €40K – €45K

description_html:
Die Minerva Biolabs GmbH ist ein international tätiges, inhabergeführtes Biotech-Unternehmen
mit Hauptsitz in Berlin. Wir entwickeln, produzieren und vermarkten Produkte zur Erkennung,
Eliminierung und Vorbeugung mikrobieller Kontaminationen.
Unsere Lösungen kommen weltweit in der wissenschaftlichen und klinischen Forschung sowie in
der Qualitätskontrolle der biopharmazeutischen Industrie zum Einsatz.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Marketing-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Product Marketing Manager (m/w/d).

Als Product Marketing Manager arbeitest du eng mit Produktmanagement, Produktentwicklung und Sales zusammen. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Produkte klar positioniert, verständlich kommuniziert und erfolgreich in den Markt eingeführt werden.
Rahmenbedingungen: unbefristete Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Standort Berlin · Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt · Home-Office nach Einarbeitung (2x pro Woche)

Aufgaben

Produktpositionierung & Marketingmaterialien
• Du entwickelst zielgruppengerechte Marketingstrategien, Positionierungen und
Kernbotschaften für bestehende sowie neue Produkte und übersetzt komplexe
wissenschaftliche Inhalte in verständliche, überzeugende Kommunikation.
• Du konzipierst, erstellst und koordinierst wissenschaftlich fundierte Marketingmaterialien – z.B. Data Sheets, Präsentationen, Poster, Flyer, Website- und Newsletter-Inhalte, Webinare, Social Media Posts und Produktschulungen.
• Du stellst in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Application Specialists und der
Produktentwicklung die wissenschaftliche und technische Qualität unserer Produktkommunikation und Marketingmaterialien sicher
• Gemeinsam mit Design und Web Development setzt du Inhalte visuell und digital um.
• Du identifizierst neue Kommunikationsformate und -kanäle für unser Produktportfolio und steuerst bei Bedarf externe Dienstleister.

Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement
• Gemeinsam mit Produktmanagement, Produktentwicklung und Sales entwickelst du Launch-Messaging, Kampagnen und Materialien für neue Produkte.
• Du planst und koordinierst digitale Marketingkampagnen zur Lead Generation und
internationalen Vermarktung.
• Auf Basis von Markt- und Vertriebsfeedback entwickelst du mit Sales und Application Specialists die Positionierung weiter. Mit Sales und Produktmanagement identifizierst du neue Marktpotenziale und Anwendungsfelder.
• Du erstellst Sales-Enablement-Materialien wie Präsentationen, Produktvergleiche und Argumentationshilfen.
• Du unterstützt Sales bei internationalen Distributor- und Kundenaktivitäten, z. B. bei
Schulungen, Messen und Roadshows.

Qualifikation

• Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Life Science, Biotechnologie, Molekularbiologie, Mikrobiologie oder einer vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlichen Fachrichtung
• Erste, idealerweise mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Produktmarketing, Produktmanagement, Vertrieb oder in einem vergleichbaren B2B-Umfeld
• Idealerweise Kenntnisse in Bereichen wie PCR/qPCR/dPCR, Qualitätskontrolle, Biopharma oder Zell- und Gentherapie
• Freude daran, komplexe wissenschaftliche Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und für
unterschiedliche Zielgruppen verständlich aufzubereiten
• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
• Eine strukturierte, selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie Organisationstalent, um mehrere Projekte und Stakeholder parallel zu koordinieren
• Eigeninitiative, Kreativität und Freude daran, eigene Ideen einzubringen und umzusetzen
• Einen ausgeprägten Teamgedanken und Freude an der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit
• Kunden- und marktorientiertes Denken

Benefits

• Ein Bruttogehalt von 4.400 – 5.600 € pro Monat, je nach Erfahrung
• Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsplatz in einem etablierten, wachsenden Biotech-Unternehmen
• Echten Gestaltungsspielraum: kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien, damit deine Ideen schnell Wirkung zeigen
• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und nach der Einarbeitung 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche
• 28 Tage Urlaub
• Individuelle Weiterbildung für deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung
• Nachhaltige Mobilität: Jobticket mit 75 % Zuschuss (nach der Probezeit), JobRad und günstiger Solarstrom für dein E-Auto
