title: Praktikum "Social Media Manager"
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at contentkueche GmbH
description_html:
Du liebst Social Media? TikTok, Insta und YouTube sind Deine Welt?! Dann geht's Dir wie uns! Komm, erstell und verbreite mit uns mega coolen Content!

Lass uns zusammen Videos, Bilder, Texte produzieren! Lern bei uns, was es heißt, in einer Social Media Redaktion zu arbeiten und wie man Spaß bei der Arbeit haben kann!

Aufgaben

  • Erstellung von Social Media Content in Bild und Wort
  • Umsetzen von Community Management
  • Betreuung der Social-Media-Kanäle (v.a. TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Youtube, Pinterest)
  • Mitarbeit an Strategiekonzepten, wie z.B. Content- und Plattformstrategie, Kampagnenkonzeption und Maßnahmenentwicklung
  • Reportings- und Handlungsempfehlungen
  • Marktbeobachtung, um Trends im Social Media Umfeld frühzeitig zu erkennen.

Qualifikation

Wir wollen dich gerne kennenlernen, weil Du:

  • ohne Social Media keinen Tag verbringst!
  • bestenfalls schon erste praktische Berufserfahrung im Social Media Umfeld hast!
  • gerne viel Zeit in der digitalen Welt verbringst und keinen Trend verpasst!
  • (Design) Know-how in und mit Neuen Medien hast!
  • ein Teamplayer bist, mit anpacken kannst und interdisziplinär am Start bist

Benefits

Wir bieten dir:

  • Viel Wissen und Spass bei der Arbeit!
  • flache Hierarchien einer inhabergeführten Agentur
  • tolle Perspektiven und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • ein Team, das sich auf deine Ideen freut, von dem du viel lernen kannst und viel Spaß bei der Arbeit hat
  • viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, deine eigenen Ideen in die Tat umzusetzen!
  • Erfahrungen, die wir gerne weitergeben!
  • spannende Projekte und Kunden aus den Bereichen Entertainment, Fitness und Freizeit

Über uns:

Die contentkueche ist eine Content Marketing Agentur aus München. Unser Fokus liegt auf Strategieentwicklung, Content-Creation, und erfolgreicher Distribution.

Wir sind ein erfolgreiches Team und arbeiten mit Leidenschaft und Spaß zusammen.

In der contentkueche darfst und sollst Du Dich kreativ entfalten. Deine Meinung wird ernst genommen und zählt. Es erwartet Dich ein schönes Office in einer Toplage.

Wir freuen uns über deine vollständige Bewerbungsunterlagen, mit Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnissen, Arbeitsproben sowie Angabe des nächstmöglichen Eintrittstermins . Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Nadine Meyer.

title: PR & Communications Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at L1VE GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a PR & Communications Manager to take responsibility for both internal and external communications. In this role, you will develop our communications work strategically and operationally, increase L1VE’s visibility among relevant media and communities, and ensure clear and consistent communication across the company.

Your Role

As PR & Communications Manager, you will be responsible for L1VE’s communications across internal and external channels. You will develop topics and messages, build relationships with media and relevant stakeholders, and support the communication of important company, product and content topics – from the initial idea through to publication.
You will combine traditional press and public relations with modern corporate communications. In this role, you will work closely with the executive team, Brand, Marketing, Content, Product and Tech, as well as with our teams in Berlin and New York.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement an integrated PR and communications strategy for L1VE, with a focus on external visibility and internal clarity
  • Identify, develop and prepare relevant topics relating to L1VE, our technologies, products, live formats and partnerships
  • Build and maintain relationships with journalists, editorial teams, media outlets, industry experts and other relevant multipliers
  • Create and place press releases, statements and background materials, and prepare media briefings, interviews and other communications formats
  • Prepare and support media conversations, interviews, events, launches and public appearances by L1VE and its executive team
  • Develop and implement internal communications formats for teams in Berlin and New York, such as company updates, leadership communications, team information and change communications
  • Ensure consistent positioning, tone of voice and messaging across internal and external communication channels
  • Monitor media coverage, topics and relevant public discourse, and identify communication opportunities and potential risks
  • Coordinate external agencies, freelancers and other communications partners, including the management of briefs, timelines and budgets
  • Measure and evaluate communications impact using relevant KPIs, media resonance and qualitative learnings

title: AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Jobgether
description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract) based in France.

As an AI Science Writer, you’ll translate cutting-edge AI and machine learning research into accurate, engaging, and accessible stories.
You’ll work at the intersection of scientific research, technical communication, journalism, and multimedia storytelling.
A core part of the role will be reviewing new models, architectures, papers, and research to identify what is genuinely novel and important.
You’ll turn complex technical concepts into compelling written and visual narratives through articles, explainers, diagrams, charts, and other formats.
You’ll engage directly with researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to investigate ideas and verify technical claims.
The role also offers opportunities to cover major conferences, host research-focused events, and experiment with AI-assisted editorial workflows.
This is an ongoing contract position with a fixed monthly retainer, flexibility, and potential opportunities for longer-term career growth.


Accountabilities
  • Produce accurate and engaging scientific and technical reviews covering new AI models, architectures, research papers, internal research, and emerging trends.
  • Analyze technical papers and research findings to identify meaningful innovations, understand methodologies, evaluate limitations, and communicate their significance.
  • Transform complex model architectures and technical concepts into clear visual narratives, including infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements.
  • Develop written content across multiple formats, including analytical reports, long-form features, interviews, technical explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social media content.
  • Interview researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to uncover insights and provide context for stories.
  • Cover major AI research conferences, emerging fields, significant developments, and important discussions across the AI ecosystem.
  • Host or moderate research webinars, interviews, and other on-camera or multimedia formats.
  • Work directly with researchers to fact-check and verify technical claims while maintaining a clear, engaging editorial voice.
  • Collaborate with designers and multimedia producers on more complex visual and interactive stories.
  • Create visual assets independently where appropriate, using AI tools and other relevant technologies to support the production process.
  • Experiment with AI models, agents, coding, and automation to improve research, editorial, analysis, and visual-production workflows.
  • Contribute to an editorial environment focused on making advanced scientific research accessible without oversimplifying its underlying complexity.

    • Requirements:

    • Professional or academic experience in AI/ML research, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
    • A degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, physics, engineering, computational science, or another relevant technical field.
    • Strong ability to read and interpret scientific papers, inspect model architectures, compare experimental results, and discuss technical details directly with researchers.
    • Strong technical writing and editorial skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts accurately, clearly, and engagingly.
    • Strong visual communication instincts and the ability to explain technical mechanisms through diagrams, infographics, charts, and other multimedia formats.
    • Ability to assess the significance and limitations of research rather than simply summarize findings.
    • Excellent interviewing and communication skills, with confidence engaging researchers, engineers, and technical experts.
    • Comfortable working across multiple content formats and adapting technical material for different audiences and channels.
    • Familiarity with LLMs and AI-assisted content or research workflows, using these tools to enhance productivity while maintaining personal editorial judgement and authorship.
    • Curiosity about emerging developments in AI, machine learning, and scientific research.
    • Strong attention to accuracy, fact-checking, and technical detail.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and collaborate effectively with researchers, designers, and multimedia professionals.
    • Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where they are based.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation through a fixed monthly contract retainer.
      • Ongoing contract engagement with opportunities for professional growth and potential transition to a full-time position.
      • Flexible working arrangements within Europe.
      • High degree of ownership over research, editorial projects, and storytelling formats.
      • Opportunities to work on impactful projects at the forefront of AI and machine learning.
      • Career growth and continuous learning opportunities.
      • Collaboration with researchers, engineers, scientific leaders, designers, and multimedia professionals.
      • International working environment with talented teams across multiple locations.
      • Opportunity to experiment with AI tools, agents, coding, and automation in modern editorial workflows.
      • Fast-moving environment where innovative ideas and individual contributions can have a visible impact.

description_html:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Assistant(e) Production Accessoires Cuir (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Chaussures, Sacs et Accessoires à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois ou d’une alternance d’un an à partir de Janvier 2027.

Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Développement et Production Accessoires, vos missions sont les suivantes :

  • Vous constituez des dossiers de dépôt de modèles ;
  • Vous vérifiez des pièces de Go Production ainsi que de Go Livraison ;
  • Vous suivez la réception des pièces de shooting ;
  • Vous aidez au contrôle de la production à l’entrepôt ;
  • Vous saisissez des descriptifs produits dans l’ERP ;
  • Vous faites le suivi des projets des tests au porter ainsi que des tests chimiques ,
  • Vous participez à l’envoi du cuir ou des pièces de référence.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) et recherchez un stage de fin d’études de 6 mois ou une alternance de 1 an ;
  • Organisé(e), autonome, rigoureux(se) et flexible, vous êtes doté(e) d'un bon relationnel ;
  • Vous avez un bel esprit d’équipe, l’envie de partager et développer vos compétences dans un environnement agile et dynamique :) 
  • Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement international et parlez pour cela un anglais courant. 

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

title: Junior Product Owner
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Erasys
description_html:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.


What We Offer

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
  • €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
  • EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
  • In-house German classes
  • Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)
  • International team, English-speaking environment

CHROMAMOS
Saarland, Germany | On-site | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / Analytical Instruments

**About ChromaMOS
**ChromaMOS has built a portable, lab-quality gas analysis device that delivers fast, dependable on-site results at a fraction of the cost of existing lab-based solutions — already validated for freshness assessment of hazelnuts, with applications spanning quality management, leakage monitoring and future breath analysis.

**The opportunity
**Built by Oliver Brieger (M.Sc. Systems Engineering, currently finishing his PhD) and Julian Joppich (M.Sc. Microtechnology and Nanostructures), ChromaMOS now has a validated 2nd-generation prototype at TRL 7 and is in discussions on LOIs with the food industry. The two engineer co-founders need a business partner to turn a validated device into an actual product and company.

Tasks

What you will own

**Company build-up & funding
**- Lead incorporation (not yet founded) and drive the EXIST Research Transfer application and other funding routes for market-ready product development.
- Own the fundraising and grant strategy alongside the two technical co-founders.
Business development & sales
- Convert ongoing food-industry conversations into signed LOIs and paying pilot customers.
- Define target markets beyond food (quality management, leakage monitoring, breath analysis) and prioritize go-to-market.
Operations, marketing & finance
- Set up the commercial, marketing and finance operations the founding engineering team doesn't yet have in place.

Requirements

What you bring

**Core experience
**- Business development, sales, marketing, operations or finance experience — ChromaMOS is open to a generalist business co-founder covering some or all of these.
- Comfort working with a deep-tech hardware product moving from validated prototype to market-ready product.
Especially valuable
- Experience with EXIST or similar German public deep-tech funding programs.
- Existing network in food industry quality management, industrial gas analysis, or analytical instruments.
- Interest in also helping recruit the team's planned 3rd (engineering/electronics) hire.

Benefits

Why join ChromaMOS
- A 2nd-generation prototype already validated at TRL 7 for a real use case (hazelnut freshness), not an early concept.
- Significantly lower cost than existing lab-based gas analysis solutions — a clear commercial wedge.
- Ground-floor equity alongside two technical co-founders who have already built the product.

ChromaMOS welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.

description_html:
GUARDSPHERE
Saarbrücken, Germany | On-site | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / OT & Industrial Cybersecurity

About GuardSphere
GuardSphere protects factories, energy plants and critical infrastructure from cyberattacks without ever stopping production. Its product, NeuroX Shield, passively watches a plant's industrial network, learns normal behavior, and lets operators respond to threats safely and gradually — built for mid-sized German manufacturers and utilities who can't afford downtime and have no in-house security specialist.

**The opportunity
**Founded around Farah Elshenawy (7 years in penetration testing, OSCP, MSc Entrepreneurial Cybersecurity at Saarland University/CISPA) and machine-learning lead Nazligul Kese, GuardSphere has validated its prototype with 47+ industry professionals across 6 industrial events and secured €800k in StartupSecure funding. What's missing is the commercial engine to turn validated R&D into revenue. We are looking for a Business / Industry co-founder specialized in OT security go-to-market, GuardSphere is separately also open to a CTO / software co-founder with OT/ICS development experience.

Tasks

What you will own

**Go-to-market & sales
**- Build GuardSphere's route into German manufacturing and utilities, converting strong customer interest (47+ contacts across 6 events) into pilots and paying customers.
- Bridge NeuroX Shield's technical capabilities with the budget and risk-appetite decision cycle of Plant Managers and CISOs.
Commercial strategy
- Understand and navigate industrial procurement processes, budgets and buying decisions in OT/manufacturing.
- Own pricing, packaging and commercial positioning as the prototype becomes a repeatable product.
Company build-up
- Lead incorporation (planned mid-2027) and support fundraising alongside Farah Elshenawy (Project Lead / CEO track).

Requirements

What you bring

**Core experience
**- Business development or sales experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity, industrial automation, or a closely related B2B industrial technology field.
- Understanding of German manufacturing and utilities procurement, budgets and decision cycles.
Especially valuable
- Existing network among Plant Managers, CISOs or OT security buyers.
- Familiarity with IEC 62443 and industrial compliance standards.
- GuardSphere is separately seeking a CTO/Developer co-founder, hands-on OT/ICS software development experience is valuable for that parallel track.

Benefits

Why join GuardSphere
- A prototype already validated through 47+ customer conversations and 6 industrial events, real market pull, not just a hypothesis.
- €800k in non-dilutive StartupSecure funding already secured.
- Ground-floor equity in a company addressing a growing, regulation-driven market (IEC 62443, rising OT/ICS attack surface).

GuardSphere welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.

description_html:
IXPLAIN
Kaiserslautern, Germany (DFKI) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / Explainable AI

About iXplain
iXplain is an AI platform for time series analysis that doesn't just detect what is happening in sensor data, but explains why. It combines state-of-the-art machine learning (classification, forecasting, regression, anomaly detection) with Explainable AI and a neuro-symbolic rule engine to turn raw industrial signals into clear, actionable recommendations, already demonstrated in water quality monitoring, energy grids and automotive production.

**The opportunity
**iXplain grew out of DFKI (German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence) and has a functional demonstrator, shown at Hannover Messe 2025, with live discussions underway in the water and manufacturing sectors. The technology is proven; the company is not yet founded. We are looking for a CEO / Business co-founder to turn a validated research demonstrator into a company, own the commercial relationship with our first industrial partners, and build the business around technology our 3-person research team has already built.

Tasks

What you will own

Company build-up
- Lead the incorporation of iXplain as a company and define its go-to-market strategy and business model.
- Own fundraising strategy and investor relations for the seed stage.
Commercial validation
- Validate iXplain with real industrial partners in water, energy and automotive/manufacturing, turning early discussions (post-Hannover Messe 2025) into paying pilots.
- Define how iXplain integrates into customers' existing workflows and systems.
Business leadership
- Build the commercial organization, pricing and sales process from scratch alongside the technical co-founders (Dr. Dominique Mercier, CTO; Dr. Tobias Wirth, Advisor).
- Represent iXplain to investors, partners and industrial customers as CEO.

Requirements

What you bring

Core experience
- Entrepreneurial / business leadership experience, ideally as a founder or in early-stage B2B SaaS or industrial-tech commercialization.
- Track record in business development and closing deals with industrial or enterprise customers.
- Comfortable operating without a playbook, pre-product-market-fit.
Especially valuable
- Domain expertise in water, energy, or automotive/manufacturing industries.
- Experience fundraising from VCs or deep-tech grants (e.g., EXIST, German public funding).
- Ability to speak the language of both data-science researchers and industrial buyers.

Benefits

Why join iXplain
- Own the CEO seat of a deep-tech AI company with a working, demonstrated product, not a slide deck.
- Backed by DFKI's research and IP in Explainable AI and neuro-symbolic reasoning.
- Equity-based co-founder role with real influence on strategy, hiring and company direction from day one.

iXplain welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.

FAMILY FLOW
Saarbrücken / Homburg, Saarland, Germany | Remote | Fulltime | Digital Health (DiGA)

About Family Flow
Family Flow is a scientifically grounded, trauma-sensitive parenting app that helps parents with their own history of adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) manage the moment between a trigger and their reaction to their child — building a personalized 'Flow Plan' (trigger → warning signs → pause → skill → parenting strategy) instead of another generic parenting app.

The opportunity
The concept is built on more than 20 years of clinical and scientific work on child maltreatment led by Prof. Dr. med. Eva Möhler, Chair of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry at Saarland University, alongside DFKI researchers Patrick Gebhard and Jan Alexandersson. The idea and clinical content are finalized — what's missing is the team and funding to build and launch the app. We are looking for a CEO / Business co-founder (fundraising, tech and operations) to turn a validated clinical concept into a real product.

Tasks

What you will own

Company build-up & fundraising
- Lead incorporation of Family Flow and raise the funding needed for app development (German, French and English versions).
- Own the path to the German DiGA directory (digital health app reimbursement) and the parallel free-market / B2C launch.

title: Technical Artist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Booming Games
description_html:
About the role

At Booming Games we are seeking a skilled and motivated Technical Artist to join our team. As a Technical Artist, you will work closely with the Art Lead and Product Owner to create visually stunning games. Your responsibilities will include preparing, exporting, optimizing, and implementing game assets and animations, creating prototypes and mock-ups, designing user interfaces and layouts, and maintaining the organization of creative assets. Additionally, you will be responsible for documenting technical specifications and guidelines for asset creation and pipeline processes. If you are a tech-oriented individual with a passion for game development and possess excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and project management abilities, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Create games in collaboration with the Product team and the Design team.
  • Prepare prototypes and mock-ups for game and feature behaviours.
  • Conceptualize visuals and develop design concepts, graphics, layouts and UI assets based on requirements.
  • Prepare documentation with technical specifications and guidelines for Game Artists and Animators.
  • Present ideas and solutions to stakeholders and incorporate their feedback.
  • Prepare and export game assets from multiple sources and tools.
  • Interface between Design and Development Teams, ensuring an optimal implementation of game assets.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience as a Graphic Designer
  • Advanced knowledge of graphic design tools, including Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Tech-oriented mindset
  • Knowledge of layouts, graphic fundamentals, visual design, typography, motion, graphics and user interface designs
  • Understanding of how static and animated assets are integrated into a game
  • Strong teamwork, time management, and project management skills
  • Fast learner, problem solving, attention to detail, and the ability to work on multiple projects
  • Willingness to take responsibility in a fast changing environment
  • Excellent communication skills to clearly align with all stakeholders
  • Familiar with JIRA, Confluence and Slack
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

Nice to have

  • Experience within the online gaming industry especially slot machines
  • Knowledge of Spine 2D animation
  • Knowledge of particle systems (Pixi)
  • Familiarity with HTML and CSS

Good to know

  • In order to be considered, please submit your CV in English and make sure to attach your portfolio
  • We kindly ask for your understanding that we can only consider applicants within the CET +/- 2 hrs
  • This full-time position can be a permanent employment in Malta or on a freelance basis for contractors in the other countries

Why Work for Booming Games

Founder led. Impact driven. Employee centric.
We come to the table with a compelling game offering for our clients. We are currently releasing an exciting game every 3 weeks, with aggressive plans to increase this to release a new game every 2 weeks. Using our cutting-edge technical expertise, we aim to shape this offering to have off-the-shelf games from which to take our pick from. We strive to establish a “one team” mentality with our internal clients, all working towards a common goal. We’re a multi-cultural and diverse team whose passions and strengths bring much joy into the work we do.

Our perks

  • We’re a 100% remote-first company, offering a best-in-class remote experience
  • Competitive package
  • Dog-friendly offices in Berlin and Malta
  • Family-friendly policies
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Zestful working environment
  • Knowledge sharing opportunities
  • Dynamic culture surrounded by industry experts
  • Company social events for team bonding

Contact

HR Team

title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Predium Technology GmbH
description_html:
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende ESG-Intelligence-Plattform für institutionelle Immobilienunternehmen in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.

Deine Mission

Als Senior Backend Engineer verantwortest du die Systeme hinter unserer Plattform: die GraphQL-API, das relationale Datenmodell, die Hintergrundverarbeitung, die Dokumente und Excel-Dateien unserer Kunden in strukturierte Daten verwandelt, und das Berechtigungsmodell, mit dem ein einzelner Eigentümer und eine Bank mit hunderten Portfolios dasselbe Produkt nutzen. Der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft vom Schema-Design bis zum Resolver.
Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Design und den anderen Engineers zusammen, damit wir das bauen, was zählt - nicht nur das, was dir gesagt wurde. Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung für Production: Wenn etwas langsam ist, findest du heraus, warum – egal ob die Antwort eine schlechte Query, Anwendungscode oder die Infrastruktur darunter ist.
Du hilfst uns außerdem, KI in Production zuverlässig zu machen. Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs und agentische Features sind zentral für die Richtung des Produkts - und wir brauchen Leute, die diese Workflows testbar und verlässlich machen, statt nur in der Demo beeindruckend.
Bei uns gewinnt die beste Idee - egal von wem sie kommt. Mit 40 Leuten gibt's einfach keinen Raum für Politik. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern.

Tech-Stack: TypeScript (NestJS im Backend, React im Frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (mehrere Datenbanken inkl. PostGIS), Queue-basierte Job-Verarbeitung, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), Infrastructure-as-Code, Claude

Was du konkret tust

  • Du baust Features über unsere Hasura GraphQL-API, NestJS und Postgres - vom Schema-Design bis zum Resolver.
  • Du modellierst komplexe Immobilien- und ESG-Domänen in relationalen Schemas. Wir betreiben mehrere Postgres-Datenbanken parallel (eine davon geospatial), und Schema-Entscheidungen haben hier langfristige Konsequenzen.
  • Du verantwortest die Hintergrundverarbeitung: Excel-Importe, Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs. Queues, Retries, Jobs, die andere Jobs starten - und die Frage, was passiert, wenn Schritt 3 von 7 um 2 Uhr nachts fehlschlägt.
  • Du entwickelst unser Berechtigungsmodell weiter. Unsere Kunden reichen vom einzelnen Eigentümer bis zum Konzern mit Zugriff auf Organisations-, Portfolio- und Gebäudeebene. Das richtig zu bauen ist echte Design-Arbeit, keine Middleware-Konfiguration.
  • Du integrierst LLMs in Backend-Workflows - vor allem für Dokumenten- und Datenextraktion - und machst sie zuverlässig und testbar.
  • Du debuggst Production. Du nutzt Grafana Dashboards und Traces, um herauszufinden, warum etwas langsam ist oder fehlschlägt - ob in der App, der CI/Build-Pipeline oder der Infrastruktur.
  • Du erkennst überwucherte oder unnötig komplexe Teile der Codebase und vereinfachst sie, ohne dass dich jemand darum bitten muss. Komplexität abzubauen gehört zum Job, ist kein Nebenprojekt.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Du hast Features end-to-end über Schema, API und Hintergrundverarbeitung ausgeliefert, die unsere Kunden aktiv nutzen.
  • Unsere asynchrone Verarbeitung (Importe, Extraktion, Analyse-Jobs) ist messbar robuster: weniger stille Fehler, klare Retry- und Recovery-Pfade und Observability, die uns sagt, was kaputt ist und warum.
  • Du hast Ownership für mindestens einen Kernbereich übernommen - z. B. das Berechtigungsmodell, die Job-Orchestrierung oder die LLM-Extraktions-Pipeline - und bist dafür die Anlaufstelle im Team.
  • Du hast Testing und Developer Experience im Backend auf ein neues Level gehoben, und andere Engineers liefern dadurch schneller.
  • Du bist für Product und das Team ein verlässlicher Sparringspartner, wenn wir entscheiden, was wir bauen und wie.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du bist stark in Postgres. Schema-Design fällt dir leicht, du kannst einen Query Plan lesen und weißt, wann das ORM dich anlügt. Geospatial-Erfahrung ist ein Bonus, keine Voraussetzung.
  • Du bist fließend in typisiertem Backend-TypeScript. Wir arbeiten täglich mit NestJS und GraphQL; wenn deine Erfahrung aus einem vergleichbaren Stack kommt, ist das völlig okay - du arbeitest dich ein.
  • Du hast echte Queue-basierte Verarbeitung gebaut. Nicht „ich habe mal einen Job in eine Queue gelegt", sondern Worker designt, Retries und Teilausfälle behandelt, mehrstufige Workflows orchestriert.
  • Du hast Authorization für ein Multi-Tenant-Produkt designt und weißt, wo es haarig wird.
  • Du hast lieber einen Integrationstest gegen eine echte Datenbank als zehn Unit-Tests, die alles mocken. Du schreibst den Test, der die kaputte Migration erwischt.
  • Du behandelst Production als debuggbares System. Du findest über Dashboards und Traces heraus, warum etwas langsam ist, und Infrastruktur ist für dich nicht das Problem von jemand anderem.
  • Du kommunizierst klar - mit Engineers, Product und bei Bedarf direkt mit Kunden.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser und fließend Englisch. Unsere Kunden sind deutsche Banken und Asset Manager, und du wirst mit ihnen sprechen.

Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) sowie Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • LLMs in Production, vor allem Dokumenten- oder Datenextraktion - und die Fähigkeit, sie zuverlässig statt nur beeindruckend zu machen.
  • Data-Pipeline-Erfahrung: stufenweise, reproduzierbare Verarbeitung, Dataset-Versionierung.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Predium Technology GmbH
description_html:
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.

Your Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.
You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome

What you'll own

  • Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.
  • Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.
  • Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.
  • Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.
  • Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.
  • Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.
  • Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.

What success looks like

  • You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.
  • Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.
  • You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.
  • You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.
  • You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.

What it takes

  • You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast.
  • You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.
  • You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy.
  • You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.
  • You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.
  • You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.
  • You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.

Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC.
  • LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows.
  • Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning.
  • Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it.
  • Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard.

Why Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.
  • Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.
  • Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.
  • Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.

description_html:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and powers data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 800 of the world's leading enterprises, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io.

About this role

Astronomer’s products run on a complex, multi-cloud platform — and the scalability, and operational maturity of that platform is what we’re actively investing in. The work ahead on our Platform team isn’t about managing data or curating pipelines; it’s about building the foundational systems that everything else runs on — the kind of systems where the failure modes matter, the latency budgets are real, and getting it wrong has visible consequences for hundreds of enterprise customers.

We’re looking for a Staff+-level engineer who has built production platform systems at scale before — not just consumed them. You’ve designed systems under load, reasoned carefully about failure, and made your colleagues’ lives better by giving them something solid and well-understood to build on top of. You write strategy documents and then write the code that proves them out. You’ve been the person who made the call, and lived with the consequences.

This is a foundational role at a consequential moment: your work will directly shape what Astronomer’s products — Astro, Observe, and our IDE — are capable of over the next several years.

What you get to do

Astronomer has a healthy and complex infrastructure estate spanning multiple cloud providers, a mix of managed and self-hosted systems, and an increasingly ambitious set of requirements as our products evolve. We have a clear sense of where we need to go; we need the right person to figure out how to get there and then go build it.

This is very much a technical role — you’ll be just as involved in building these systems as in specifying and designing them. We’re not looking for someone to write strategy documents; we’re looking for someone who writes the strategy and the code, and who has done exactly that before at scale.

  • Blaze a Trail: Own and develop our platform infrastructure strategy, with the sponsorship and responsibility to match. Map out what we need, make the calls, and own the outcomes.

  • Be an Owner: Be directly involved in deciding what we work on and how we work on it. Make promises, and keep them.

  • Do Sensible Things: Make principled build vs. buy assessments and advocate for the right tools for the right job — not the fashionable ones, not the ones already in the estate just because they’re there.

  • Garage Door Open: Create and maintain comprehensive internal documentation and decision records for systems and processes. Participate in architectural forums and make principled, open decisions that the rest of the organisation can learn from and hold us to.

What you bring to the role

  • Distributed systems depth, grounded in practice. You have a solid working model of how production systems fail — consistency and availability tradeoffs, failure cascades, backpressure, graceful degradation. You can draw the diagram, explain the failure modes at each node, and make a reasoned argument for which ones actually matter in a given context. NALSD thinking is how you naturally approach a new system design.

  • Kubernetes at operator depth. You know what happens inside the scheduler and the control loop when things go wrong, because you’ve been there. You’ve operated clusters under real load, not just deployed workloads onto them.

  • Strong Go proficiency. The platform team writes production Go. You should be fluent: you’ve built and shipped systems in it, and you have opinions about what good Go looks like.

  • Multi-cloud experience, not just multi-cloud exposure. You’ve made considered architectural decisions across AWS, GCP, and/or Azure — not just consumed managed services, but evaluated tradeoffs between them and lived with those decisions in production.

  • Experience defining requirements and driving technology choices across an engineering organization. You’ve been the person in the room who frames the decision correctly, not just the one who executes it.

  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a design doc that changes minds, and a postmortem that makes the organisation smarter. You’ve worked effectively in a globally-distributed team.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience with storage primitives at the system level — you’ve reasoned about when to reach for a relational store vs. an object store vs. something else, and you have real opinions informed by real failures.

  • Experience working on a SaaS/PaaS product across multiple cloud providers.

  • Familiarity with Apache Airflow or workflow orchestration systems.

The estimated total compensation for this role ranges from £135,000 - £185,000, along with an equity component and a comprehensive benefits package. This range is merely an estimate, and the width of the range reflects willingness to consider candidates with broad prior seniority. Actual compensation may deviate from this range based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

 
 

At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

description_html:
WHO WE ARE

Trustly is leading the human centric payments revolution. To us, this means passionately building the most convenient, intelligent and responsible way of paying for things online. Whether it's for shopping, paying subscriptions, funding trading accounts, booking airfare, playing online games and much more, we're all about a better way to pay. At our core, we are a tech company with industry leading tech capabilities. But it's the ingenuity of our people that makes us leaders in our field. Thus, our appetite for innovation will never be anything less than fierce. Trustly is steadily growing as it connects thousands of businesses with hundreds of millions of people. And with a strong presence across Europe and the Americas, we are leading the human centric payment revolution as a truly global team.

This role is in the Financial Reporting and Accounting team, part of the Group Internal Finance team at Trustly, which also comprises Tax, Treasury, Payroll, Finance Operations and Finance Systems. The team is a dynamic and cross jurisdictional team, with an ethos of collaboration and continued improvement at its heart.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Accountant at Trustly, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining the integrity of our financial statements, executing day to day general ledger accounting, and ensuring full regulatory and tax compliance across our US entities, based from our London office.

Working in a high growth FinTech environment, you will handle monthly financial closings, bank and account reconciliations, variance analysis, and internal controls under US GAAP. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail oriented accounting professional looking to step into an innovative global payments business and build scalable financial processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Month End Close: Execute month end, quarter end, and year end close routines, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and intercompany reconciliations in accordance with US GAAP.

  • Financial Reporting: Prepare accurate balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow reconciliations, investigating and resolving variances promptly.

  • Cash and Treasury Accounting: Monitor daily bank movements, perform bank reconciliations across multi currency accounts, and track working capital requirements.

  • Tax and Statutory Compliance: Support quarterly and annual US federal, state, and local tax filings (corporate income tax, sales and use tax, commercial rent tax) in coordination with external tax advisors.

  • Audit Management: Serve as a key point of contact for external auditors during annual financial audits, preparing audit schedules, documentation, and workpapers.

  • Process Improvement and Systems: Support the implementation, optimization, and automation of core financial systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, ERP platforms) and internal controls (SOX readiness).

  • Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner with US Payroll, FP&A, Accounts Payable, and Global Finance teams to streamline cross departmental financial inputs and reporting.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will have:

  • ACA qualified (or equivalent), alongside experience working with US GAAP.

  • Relevant accounting experience, preferably from practice.

  • Solid command of US GAAP principles, financial statement consolidation, and intercompany accounting.

  • Hands on experience with mid to enterprise ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Workday Accounting) and advanced Excel capabilities (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables).

  • Meticulous attention to detail, strong analytical capability, and the ability to operate independently in a fast paced environment.

Our Fantastic Benefits (varies by location)

🌴 25 days of holiday to support a healthy work life balance
🥳 Monthly team outing allowance to enjoy social events with your colleagues
👶 Parental leave top up, additional support for new parents
🥐 Daily breakfast and on site perks to make your workday smoother
💚 Wellbeing support, our health allowance covers gym memberships, massages, and much more to help you feel your best
PLUS additional benefits designed to enhance your work life experience!

Shape Your Role and Make an Impact

Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change, and continuously embrace new challenges. We're looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation.

Compensation: £60K – £65K

title: Senior/Lead Quality Engineer - Chatbot
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mimica
description_html:
What we are building

Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.

At the click of a button, Mimica identifies every process improvement and agentic AI opportunity across an enterprise. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Your mission

We are looking for a Quality Engineer to help us build a faster, and more reliable testing and release processes for one of our latest product engineering teams. You will work closely with Software and Machine Learning Engineers to establish the quality foundations for a product characterised by dynamic, non-deterministic outputs.

The team is a newly formed multidisciplinary team of 5 responsible for the conversational AI components across our WebApp. As the team’s founding Quality Engineer, you will play a central role in defining how we approach quality from the outset. You will introduce thoughtful, pragmatic practices that increase confidence in releases, reduce remediation and rollback work, and enable the team to move quickly without compromising user trust or product reliability.

You will have meaningful ownership from day one: exploring testing approaches, identifying quality gaps, and helping shape the systems and processes that support sustainable delivery. This is an opportunity for someone who thrives in ambiguity, combines hands-on technical testing with experimentation, and wants to define quality engineering at the intersection of software development and LLM-powered products.

Part of your day-to-day

  • Develop and evolve quality practices, test strategy, and release processes for the Chatbot product.

  • Help establish and run an output-evaluation framework for assessing Chatbot quality, reliability, and regressions.

  • Test dynamic and non-deterministic LLM-based systems, designing pragmatic approaches for validating behaviour beyond conventional deterministic test cases.

  • Identify, test, and improve guardrails for AI-specific risks, including prompt-injection scenarios and unsafe or unexpected model behaviour.

  • Partner with engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and collaborative debugging to improve quality earlier in the development lifecycle.

  • Investigate current testing gaps, research relevant methods and tools, and make evidence-based recommendations to the team.

  • Design proof-of-concepts for new testing approaches or tooling, then help productionise the solutions that create the most value.

  • Support the evolution of release testing, including clearer quality signals and release-readiness criteria.

  • Contribute performance-testing thinking for LLM-powered workflows where relevant.

  • Share knowledge, facilitate technical discussions, and build the Quality Chapter across the wider engineering organisation.

 

Requirements / What we’re looking for

  • Strong hands-on experience in software quality engineering, SDET, test automation, or a closely related engineering role.

  • Experience testing chatbot, conversational AI, RAG, LLM-powered, or other systems with dynamic and non-deterministic behaviour; even early practical exposure is valuable.

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language and enough technical depth to understand production code, contribute to code reviews, and collaborate effectively with software engineers.

  • An experimental, investigative mindset: you can explore an uncertain problem space, assess alternatives, and turn findings into practical improvements.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts, testing risks, design choices, and trade-offs.

  • Strong collaboration skills and a pragmatic approach to working with Product, Engineering, and ML colleagues.

  • Good judgement in prioritising quality work based on risk, user impact, and delivery goals.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI security and safety testing.

  • Experience testing conversational AI, chatbot platforms, or agentic workflows.

  • Experience as the first Quality Engineer in a team.

  • Experience mentoring engineers or influencing testing practices across a cross-functional team.

  • Keeps pace with industry developments and actively fosters knowledge sharing by bringing new tech trends and methodology back to the team

Hiring Process

Stage 1 | Recruiter Screen (30 mins)

Stage 2 | HM Interview (45 mins)

Stage 3 | Take-home + Live Follow-up (60 mins) with members from the Chatbot team + Quality Chapter.

Stage 4 | Behavioral Interview (60 mins) with Co-founder/CTO + Lead Quality Engineer

Location

This is a fully remote position. You can be based anywhere in the UK, Americas, or Europe within a UTC-5 to UTC+1 timezone.

What we offer

💰 Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills.

🏢 Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix.

💻 Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget

📍 Flexible schedules and location

☀️ Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays

🍼 Enhanced parental leave

🧘‍♀️ Health & retirement benefits

📖 Annual learning & development budget

🌴 Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials

🌍 Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work

Note: Some benefits may vary depending on location and role

description_html:
About Swap

Swap is the infrastructure behind modern agentic commerce. The only AI-native platform connecting backend operations with a forward-thinking storefront experience.

Built for brands that want to sell anything - anywhere, Swap centralises global operations, powers intelligent workflows, and unlocks margin-protecting decisions with real-time data and capability. Our products span cross-border, tax, returns, demand planning, and our next-generation agentic storefront, giving merchants full transparency and the ability to act with confidence.

At Swap, we’re building a culture that values clarity, creativity, and shared ownership as we redefine how global commerce works.

About the role

We’re hiring a Technical Support Manager to provide senior, cross-product technical leadership across Swap’s Support organisation. This is a horizontal, high-impact role focused on technical escalation ownership, operational consistency, and scaling Technical Support (particularly in the US) as our customer base and product suite grow. You’ll act as the senior technical authority within Support driving prioritisation, improving technical readiness, and strengthening collaboration across Product and Engineering.

This role blends strategic oversight with hands-on execution and people leadership. This is not a product-specific role. You’ll operate across products, regions, and teams to ensure a clear technical ownership of complex, high-impact escalations, strong prioritisation and structured escalation pathways. Operational consistency as headcount and complexity grow and scalable systems, processes, and tooling for Technical Support. You’ll complement our global leadership by adding strong day-to-day technical management and execution as the team expands.


What You Will Do

  • Own technical readiness across all Swap products, ensuring Support teams are prepared for launches, changes, and increasing scale.

  • Act as a senior technical authority across products, setting standards for troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution quality.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on readiness reviews, risk identification, and support impact for roadmap changes.

  • Support a follow-the-sun model, ensuring consistent technical coverage and decision-making across regions.

  • Serve as the primary owner for high-severity, high-visibility, and executive technical escalations across regions and products.

  • Define and drive clear prioritisation frameworks for incidents, escalations, and competing customer needs.

  • Coordinate cross-functionally to ensure fast, durable resolutions and strong post-incident learning and follow-up.

What we would like to see

  • Manage, coach, and develop Technical Support team members as headcount increases, particularly in the US.

  • Build clarity around ownership, expectations, and career progression within Technical Support.

  • Raise the bar for technical capability, operational maturity, and customer impact across the team.

  • Establish and maintain consistent global processes for escalations, incident management, and cross-team communication.

  • Partner with Support Operations to improve tooling, workflows, and metrics that enable scale.

  • Use data and trends to monitor queue health, identify systemic issues, anticipate risk, and inform strategic decisions.

  • Lead the adoption of AI-driven support workflows, including intelligent routing, automated triage, and escalation detection.

  • Partner with Support Operations, Product, and Engineering to design and implement automations that improve speed, consistency, and scalability.

  • Use AI-assisted tooling to improve prioritisation, root-cause detection, and knowledge surfacing for agents.

  • Ensure AI systems are safe, explainable, and aligned with customer trust, security, and compliance requirements.

Nice to have

  • Experience in ecommerce, logistics, or post-purchase platforms.

  • Experience operating global or follow-the-sun support teams.

  • Familiarity with AI copilots, LLM-powered knowledge bases, or automated incident detection.

  • Experience in a scale-up or hyper-growth environment.

Diversity & Equal Opportunities:

We embrace diversity and equality in a serious way. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills, and views. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Creating a culture of equality isn't just the right thing to do; it's also the smart thing.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer

description_html:
Scope automates the data collection that’s slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We’re building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the world’s largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started, with ambitions. We have grown revenue 5x in the last year and on track to reach 10M ARR in 2026. We work with 6 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We’ve assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.

 

About the role:

Our Engineers are forward deployed focused, working closely with clients. You’ll sit at the front line of our key accounts. You will be running the rollout, and building tools tailored for the client. You won’t be handed a ticket and told to stay in your lane. You’ll own the relationship and the technical delivery, end to end.

We work in person five days a week from our sunny office in Farringdon, plus time onsite with clients. We believe being together helps us move faster and solve problems more effectively and it's also more fun!

We’re looking for someone who wants to be the person a client trusts to make Scope work for them and is technical enough to solve real problems on the spot.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Own our key accounts through the pipeline: from technical scoping, through to implementation ensuring a smooth process for the client that’s live and happy.

  • Spend time with inspectors in factories and chemical plants. Understand how they work and tailor solutions for them.

  • Run the project plan for each rollout: timelines, blockers, who needs what and by when.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Platform Leaning)

description_html:
Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup based in London, founded by Guy Podjarny, who previously founded Snyk. We’ve raised more than $100 million from world-class investors, including Index Ventures, Accel, GV and Boldstart. In 2025, Tessl ranked #2 in Sifted’s B2B SaaS Rising 100 and #20 in its AI 100.

We’re building the context layer for AI coding agents and a platform for AI-native software development. As an early member of the team, you’ll help shape how we build and scale a company operating at the forefront of AI and software development.

Overview of role

Join our engineering team to build real-time AI Native workflows, tooling, and interfaces that will reshape how developers create and maintain software.

This is a product engineering role with a platform twist. Most of your time, you'll do what every Tessl engineer does: design, prototype and ship product features end to end, collaborating closely with product, design and the wider engineering team in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment. What makes you different is that when the work goes below the application layer, you light up rather than back away: complex networking scenarios such as site-to-site VPN and private connectivity, multi-cloud and multi-region deployments, observability, and the machinery that makes Tessl straightforward to deploy, operate and support wherever it needs to run.

We expect you to be relentlessly AI native about it: instead of triaging alerts at 2 am, you'll build or deploy the agent that does it. Instead of reacting to scaling bottlenecks, you'll create systems that spot them before they happen. Deep expertise is the foundation, because you can't automate what you don't know, but your ambition should be to make agents do the bulk of the operational work, with you supervising and steering.

We're open on level for this role, from mid-level to senior: trajectory and appetite matter more to us than years.

What success looks like: Within your first year, you're shipping product features end to end like any Tessl engineer. When infrastructure work arises, from deployment architecture to networking to observability, you're the one who takes it on and lands it well, with support where you need it. Our deployment and operational practices are stronger because of you, agentic tooling handles a growing share of the toil, and the infrastructure work you touch is compliant by default, keeping our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 journey unblocked.

What you'll do

No two days will be the same at Tessl! You'll have a high level of autonomy and be empowered to make decisions based on what you believe will help you deliver the most success. Here's an insight into just a few of the things you would be doing:

Product engineering (most of your time)

  • Design and implement new functionality end to end, from initial design and prototypes to fully scoped production implementations, reviewed with the product team

  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities to prove or disprove an idea, then develop a plan for a scalable implementation

  • Pair with designers and other engineers to make the experience intuitive and slick, and integrate third-party services so we can focus our cycles on Tessl's core capabilities

  • Gather requirements from customers and stakeholders, turn ambiguity into agreed plans, and deliver them

Platform & infrastructure

  • Lean into infrastructure work as it arises: our AWS estate (EKS/Kubernetes), infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and our observability stack (Dash0/OpenTelemetry, Sentry, PostHog)

  • Contribute to the architecture & build of our more complex networking and deployment scenarios, such as private connectivity and multi-region setups

  • Improve developer experience and platform ergonomics so every engineer at Tessl ships faster

  • Partner with our Infosec team so that everything you build is compliant by default, contributing infrastructure controls and evidence towards ISO 27001 and SOC 2

AI-native automation

  • Build or deploy agentic tooling that picks up firing alerts and works through diagnostic steps autonomously, giving a human supervisor a detailed assessment with recommended actions

  • Build agents that keep our estate healthy without human toil: dependency upgrades that test and merge themselves, alerts that arrive pre-diagnosed, runbooks that execute instead of sitting in a wiki

  • Continuously spot repetitive manual work, across product, platform and on-call workflows, and convert it into agent-driven automation

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is as excited as we are to be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of AI and software development. We're committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Must-haves

  • Proven experience as a Software Engineer (TypeScript/Node preferred): you care about code modularity, structure and aesthetics, and you're equally comfortable contributing to a mature codebase with strict CI criteria or hacking up a quick prototype to prove an assumption

  • A genuine pull towards platform and infrastructure work, backed by hands-on experience: you've deployed and operated real systems (Kubernetes, cloud environments, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD), and when the chance came to go deeper, you took it, whether that was owning platform or DevOps work in a previous role or picking up the infrastructure tasks nobody else wanted

  • Solid systems and networking fundamentals: DNS, TLS, VPCs, firewalls; you can reason and debug below the application layer with confidence

  • Demonstrated use of AI coding tools and agents to accelerate your own work, and excitement about experimenting with new AI approaches to transform how engineering is done

  • Comfortable with fast-paced, high-autonomy environments: you turn loose requirements into plans and shipped work without waiting to be told

Nice-to-haves

  • You self-host things for fun: a homelab, your own services, a Kubernetes cluster nobody asked you to run

  • Production AWS/EKS experience, or hands-on work with private connectivity, VPNs, or multi-region architectures

  • Experience producing infrastructure evidence for certifications such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2

  • You've thrived in an early-stage startup before

  • Have a cool project to show us (GitHub links welcome!)

The kind of person you are

  • You're a product engineer first: you measure infrastructure by what it lets the team ship, and you see platform work as making every engineer faster, never a domain to guard

  • You're calm under pressure, including when production is misbehaving and the answer is three layers down the stack

  • You think big about how AI changes the job: the best engineers automate themselves out of the repetitive loop and operate at the scale of a team

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change, and you grab a shovel when something needs doing outside your lane

  • You communicate clearly and bring people along: product, security, engineers and customers all need to trust your judgement

Salary and benefits

Office: Our brand new 10,000 sq. ft office is in the AI hub of Kings Cross, London. We have generous catering and have regular social events such as team lunches, drinks and more. We require all staff to be in our London HQ at least 3 days a week on our anchor days of Monday, Tuesday and Thursday.

Salary: We offer a competitive salary commensurate with experience and skills and employee share options, benchmarked against industry standards.

Benefits: 25 days holiday, health insurance, including dental and vision, which extends to partners and dependents, as well as a company-matched pension. We also provide a commuting stipend for those who live outside London, and a cycle to work scheme.

Application Process

Here's an outline of what you can expect during our interview process:

  1. Introductory Call with one of our engineering leaders. A relaxed chat to learn about your background, interests, and career goals. We'll also share more about the role, Tessl's vision, and answer any questions you have.

  2. Take-Home Exercise. You'll receive a practical challenge based on real scenarios you might tackle at Tessl: an opportunity to showcase your approach to problem-solving on your own schedule.

  3. On-site Technical Session. You'll pair with two of our lead engineers to build on your take-home exercise. This session simulates working together on real problems and allows us to explore your technical expertise more deeply.

  4. Culture Conversation with our People Lead. A two-way dialogue about our values, team dynamic, and your motivations. Feel free to ask about life at Tessl, growth opportunities, or anything else you're curious about.

  5. Leadership Discussion with Maurilio (Head of Engineering), and potentially also with Guy (CEO) or Dru (Head of Product). Our final stage focuses on strategic alignment and long-term vision. You'll learn more about Tessl's roadmap and how you could contribute to our mission.

Throughout the process, if you have any specific requirements or need adjustments, please let us know: we're happy to accommodate.


We care deeply about the warm, inclusive environment we’re building at Tessl and we value diversity – we welcome applications from those typically underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this role but are not totally sure whether you’re the right person, do apply anyway!

Launch your product career at Europe's leading music education platform

Matchspace Music is Europe's leading music education platform. We help thousands of music teachers build sustainable careers from teaching, and we are scaling fast across international markets. You will work directly with our VP Product.

This is a role for someone hungry. You want to see how a product is discovered, specified, built, shipped, measured and improved, and you want to be hands-on across the whole cycle. Tasks

  • UAT, QA and testing. Own regression and release testing. Reproduce defects properly, keep the bug board honest, and support UAT and end-to-end dry runs.
  • Analytics and performance measurement. Own recurring KPI reporting across our tool stack, close measurement gaps, and turn funnel and cohort data into insight the team acts on. Every feature we ship is measured against the question: did it work? What was the impact?

Requirements

  • A relevant degree in business engineering, IT, information systems, digital business administration, or a related field, whether ongoing or recently completed.
  • Analytical and creative. You enjoy digging into data to find the real problem, and you are creative about how to solve it. Build-measure-learn is how you already think.
  • Structured and detail oriented. You find clean documentation and reproducible analysis satisfying, not tedious.
  • Comfortable with data. Excel/Sheets at a solid level, able to read dashboards, willing to learn fast
  • Comfortable and confident with software development technicalities, with viewing software code and understanding code with the help of AI
  • Proficient in German (min. B2) and English (C1). You can write a requirement someone else can build from. Your main operating language is English. German is essential for our Swiss home market.
  • Already using AI tools in your daily productivity workflow and genuinely curious about how software gets built.
  • Self-managing in a fast-moving, distributed team.

Nice to have
