title: B2B Partnerships & Influencer Marketing Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at YAZIO
description_html:
HALLO

Bist du bereit, die Zukunft von B2B-Partnerschaften im DACH-Markt und darüber hinaus mitzugestalten?

Wir suchen einen Partnerships Manager mit Drive, einem starken Netzwerk und einem tiefen Verständnis für den deutschsprachigen Markt. Du erkennst spannende Kooperationsmöglichkeiten, gehst proaktiv auf potenzielle Partner zu, entwickelst überzeugende Konzepte und verhandelst Partnerschaften, von denen beide Seiten profitieren.

Dabei übernimmst du den gesamten Partnership-Lifecycle – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über Verhandlungen und Kampagnen-Launches bis hin zum langfristigen Beziehungsmanagement. Du analysierst, was funktioniert, optimierst kontinuierlich und skalierst erfolgreiche Partnerschaften.

Wenn du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest, Chancen erkennst, bevor andere sie sehen, und aus guten Ideen messbare Ergebnisse machst, könnte das dein nächster Step sein.

Diese Rolle ist zu 100 % remote und offen für Kandidaten mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland, Spanien, Portugal oder Großbritannien.

DEINE MISSION

  • Du baust strategische Partnerschaften in der DACH-Region und auf internationalen Märkten auf, entwickelst sie weiter und skalierst sie – von klassischen B2B-Kooperationen bis hin zu Influencer- und Creator-Partnerschaften.

  • Du identifizierst spannende Partner, sprichst sie proaktiv an und führst sie vom ersten Kontakt über die Verhandlung und das Onboarding bis hin zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

  • Du entwickelst kreative Partnerschaftskonzepte und Kampagnen, die zu unserer Marke, unseren Zielen und den jeweiligen Partnern passen.

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Partnership-Lifecycle – inklusive Verhandlungen, Briefings, Freigabeprozessen, Onboarding und laufendem Beziehungsmanagement.

  • Du bewertest potenzielle Partner anhand von Brand Fit, Zielgruppe, Content-Qualität und relevanten Performance-KPIs.

  • Du entwickelst neue Partnerschaftsmodelle und Kampagnen mit einem besonderen Fokus auf B2B-Partnerschaftensowie Revenue-Share-Kooperationen mit Influencer und Creators.

  • Du misst die Performance deiner Partnerschaften, leitest konkrete Insights ab und optimierst bestehende sowie zukünftige Initiativen kontinuierlich.

  • Du entwickelst skalierbare Prozesse innerhalb des Partnerships-Teams weiter und nutzt Automatisierung und Workflow-Optimierung, um effizienter zu arbeiten.

  • Du behältst auch die operativen Details im Blick – von Vertragsmanagement und Dokumentation bis hin zu Rechnungsstellung und administrativen Prozessen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams und externen Partnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass Kampagnen und Projekte reibungslos umgesetzt werden.

  • Du repräsentierst das Unternehmen auf Branchenevents, Konferenzen und Networking-Veranstaltungen und baust dein Netzwerk kontinuierlich aus.

  • Je nach Bedarf unterstützt du bei Influencer-Events und Creator-Aktivierungen.

DEIN PROFIL

  • Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Partnership-Management mit und kennst den DACH-Markt.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, B2B-Partnerschaften aufzubauen, zu verhandeln und langfristig zu entwickeln.

  • Erfahrung mit Influencern, Creators oder Content-Partnern ist ein großes Plus.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, souverän und authentisch und hast ein natürliches Talent dafür, Vertrauen und langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen.

  • Du hast ein Growth Mindset: Du bist neugierig, ambitioniert und möchtest Dinge nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln.

  • Du bist kreativ und kannst aus einer Idee ein konkretes Partnerschaftskonzept oder eine Kampagne entwickeln.

  • Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig, bist gleichzeitig ein Teamplayer und fühlst dich in einem schnelllebigen, dynamischen Umfeld wohl.

  • Networking liegt dir: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, baust schnell neue Kontakte auf und pflegst dein Netzwerk aktiv.

  • Du bist proaktiv und selbstbewusst in der Ansprache potenzieller Partner – egal ob auf Events, per Telefon, LinkedIn oder E-Mail.

  • Du bringst starke Verhandlungsfähigkeiten mit und hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, Win-Win-Situationen zu schaffen.

  • Du bist energiegeladen, hands-on und hast echte Begeisterung für Partnerships, Influencer Marketing und die Creator Economy.

  • Du interessierst dich für Social Media, Content, Influencer Marketing und die Entwicklung der Creator Economy.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch und kannst dich sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich sicher ausdrücken. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Wir suchen jemanden, der beide Welten versteht: den strategischen Aufbau wertvoller B2B-Partnerschaften und die Entwicklung von Kampagnen, mit denen Menschen tatsächlich interagieren möchten.

Dein Background könnte in Partnerships, Influencer Marketing, Creator Marketing, Brand Marketing, Business Development oder einer Kombination daraus liegen. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht dein exakter Jobtitel, sondern dass du Beziehungen aufbauen, Chancen erkennen und Partnerschaften in messbare Ergebnisse verwandeln kannst.

WARUM WIR?

  • Ein spannendes Produkt mit Millionen von Nutzern in über 150 Ländern, angetrieben von unserer Mission, die Welt durch gesunde Ernährung zu verändern

  • Ein Remote-First-Setup: Arbeite zu 100 % von zu Hause aus, nutze einen Co-Working-Space oder arbeite mehrere Wochen im Jahr im Ausland

  • 30 Urlaubstage zum Entspannen und Auftanken, plus 5 Kind-Krankheitstage, falls dein Kind dich braucht

  • Eine fokussierte Unternehmenskultur, die Effizienz über lange Arbeitszeiten stellt – keine Überstunden-Erwartungen, und falls doch, bekommst du diese Zeit zurück!

  • Ein wirkungsstarkes Umfeld, in dem deine Arbeit echten Wandel bewirkt – kurze Entscheidungswege und kein Mikromanagement

  • Eine Teamkultur, in der Ambition und Ausgeglichenheit Hand in Hand gehen, unterstützt durch starke Verbindungen – von unserem vollständig finanzierten Firmenretreat bis hin zu Team-Meetups und virtuellen Kaffeepausen

  • Tools und Unterstützung, um deine beste Arbeit zu leisten: MacBook, Monitor und ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 €, dazu regelmäßiges Feedback und Karriereentwicklung

  • Ein wirklich internationales Team mit Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und einem gemeinsamen Bekenntnis zu Wachstum und Wohlbefinden – unterstützt durch Sunday Supplements und Nilo Health

DIVERSITY UND INKLUSION

Bei YAZIO glauben wir, dass Vielfalt Innovation antreibt. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem sich jeder – unabhängig von Geschlechtsidentität, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Fähigkeiten – wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlt. Wir feiern unterschiedliche Perspektiven und ermutigen aktiv Menschen aus allen Hintergründen, sich zu bewerben.

STARTKLAR?

Bist du bereit, YAZIO auf die nächste Stufe zu heben und Menschen weltweit dabei zu helfen, gesünder zu leben? Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören! Bitte sende uns:

  • Deinen Lebenslauf auf Englisch

  • Ein paar Zeilen (oder gerne ein kurzes Video), wer du bist und warum du bei YAZIO arbeiten möchtest

  • Zusätzliche Materialien, die deine Arbeit zeigen (z. B. LinkedIn-Profil, Portfolio)

title: Account Executive - Mid Market

description_html:
About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $10M ARR, with an 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

About The Role

We're looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive to build and close pipeline in our larger accounts. Bigger deals, more people in the room, and a real commercial case to make. You'll own it end to end, from the first cold conversation to signature.

You'll build your own pipeline into named accounts, work with the SDR team on coverage, and run the full cycle from there: multi-threading across the account and building the commercial narrative that gets AI search visibility onto a team's budget. We are defining the category, so part of the job is teaching the market what good looks like, not waiting for a buyer who already knows they need this.

What You'll Do

  • Own and run the full sales cycle from first meeting to close across mid-market accounts

  • Multi-thread across marketing, SEO, growth, and procurement stakeholders, and build the business case that gets a deal signed

  • Generate your own pipeline into named accounts, and partner with SDRs and Marketing on targeted outbound and ABM across the patch

  • Keep the CRM and pipeline organised, with a strong handle on forecasting and deal progression

  • Share customer feedback and work with product and engineering to shape what we build

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in a quota-carrying software sales role, closing mid-market deals end to end

  • A consistent track record of overachievement against quota

  • Experience running multi-stakeholder deals, including building business cases and navigating procurement

  • A builder of your own pipeline: you can point to closed deals that started with your own prospecting, not a lead that landed in your inbox

  • Excellent communication skills and a natural ability for storytelling

  • Comfortable selling in a category that is still being defined, where you shape the buyer's thinking rather than respond to an existing budget line

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling SEO, analytics, or martech software

  • Experience in a high-growth, venture-backed startup environment

  • A track record of selling to marketing, SEO, or growth buyers

  • Repeatedly achieving president's club

What We Offer

  • Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe's fastest-growing Series A startups

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity: everyone at Peec owns a piece of the upside

  • Paid Meal and Uber home when working late

  • The most beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin

Compensation: €110K – €130K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

You'll join our Ops team right at the intersection of compliance and strategy. Alongside our Fund Compliance Manager, you'll get hands-on with recurring regulatory reporting cycles across a fast-growing portfolio of fund clients, and as you find your footing, you'll get real opportunities to contribute to the process, tooling, and automation work that shapes how the whole team operates. This isn't a role where you'll be handed a task list and left on your own; it's one where good ideas about doing things better are actively wanted.

Your Role

  • Get hands-on with monthly German compliance reporting, Bundesbank reports, AIFMD filings, and FATCA/CRS cycles across a diverse portfolio of fund clients. You'll see how regulation actually works in practice, not just in theory.

  • Collect, review, and verify data and documentation from various stakeholders across our fund clients, spotting inconsistencies, missing pieces, or red flags before they become bigger problems. You'll take ownership of the workstreams that keep this data accurate and our compliance process running smoothly. Think of it as detective work with real regulatory stakes.

  • Beyond the day-to-day, you'll have real opportunities to shape the bigger picture - improving tracking tools, documenting processes, and contributing to automation initiatives that our compliance team is actively driving forward. As you settle into the core workflows, these opportunities naturally grow alongside you. Good ideas here don't just get heard, they get built.


About you

  • Exceptionally detail-oriented and thrives in structured environments

  • Previous experience in banking, legal, or regulatory-related roles is a strong plus, though genuine interest in financial services or fund operations matters just as much if coming from a different background

  • Proactive mindset and strong risk awareness — notices when something's slightly off before it becomes a real problem, and knows when to raise it early

  • Currently enrolled in a related field such as business, law, or finance

  • Structured, detail-oriented working style paired with genuine curiosity about the reasoning behind a process

  • Comfortable owning recurring responsibilities, and just as comfortable questioning and improving them

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and German

  • Comfort with Excel, ideally with some familiarity with tools like Notion, Asana, or Google Sheets

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Make your mark in a mission-driven FinTech startup that values each of its bunchies

  • Be mentored by experienced operators and founders, that take your development seriously

  • Work from an amazing office right in Berlin-Mitte and be part of a welcoming and motivated team

  • Learn fast in a culture that values ownership, creativity, and trust and always strives to empower others

  • Additionally enjoy benefits in mobility, food and learning

  • Take part in a network of people passionate about investment and work closely with the most interesting players in the private market.

  • Benefit from working with a diverse mix of talents, unrivalled energy, and team spirit within a culture of drive and ownership

  • Flexible hours and a hybrid office setup (3 days/week in office)

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at TYTAN Technologies GmbH
description_html:
At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We're looking for a proactive Working Student to support our Operations team in a dynamic, growing environment. You'll help coordinate projects, improve processes, and ensure teams stay aligned while gaining practical experience across production, procurement, and testing activities.

Your Roadmap to make an Impact

  • Support cross-functional projects by gathering, consolidating, and maintaining project data, ensuring clear visibility of progress, open tasks, and potential risks.

  • Coordinate with production, procurement, and program teams to follow up on open topics, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure smooth communication between stakeholders.

  • Assist in improving operational processes by identifying inefficiencies, contributing ideas, and supporting the implementation of scalable solutions.

  • Provide hands-on support in the preparation, coordination, and execution of test campaigns.

  • Contribute to strategic operations projects, including the development of scalable test planning and verification frameworks and continuous improvement initiatives across the Operations team.

  • Help maintain project documentation, track action items, and support reporting to ensure timely project delivery.


  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or a related field.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Structured and analytical mindset with strong attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills and confidence working with cross-functional teams.

  • Proactive, hands-on attitude with a willingness to take ownership and follow up on open topics.

  • Genuine Interest in operations, manufacturing, testing, and continuous process improvement.

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus.

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Monthly allowances: €68/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

title: Engineering Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Workmotion
description_html:
Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET)

Contract type: Full-time

Salary: Starting from €60,000 per annum gross, subject to location, skills and experience

Not Your Typical Workplace.…

Tired of the 9-to-5 grind? Imagine a World without borders, where opportunities are endless. That's the future of work, and what we are building at WorkMotion.Our remote-first team spans across the world, helping companies hire, onboard, and manage talent internationally through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Fast-paced, people-driven, and globally connected — we empower businesses to build teams without borders.

More Than a Role.…

We don’t just need an Engineering Manager — a deep understanding of software engineering, can challenge technical decisions, coach engineers, improve engineering practices, and create an environment where teams consistently deliver meaningful outcomes. Do you enjoy building strong teams, have a strong Java engineering background, want to stay close to technology, and can turn ambitious product goals into reliable execution? We'd love to hear from you.

This isn’t a role for someone who wants to stay in their lane. You’ll be at the center of it all — ross-functional engineering team responsible for delivering reliable, scalable, and high-quality product capabilities. 

You won’t be a solo operator. You’ll collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering leaders, Principal Engineers, Platform, AI/ML, Security, and other stakeholders across WorkMotion bringing everything together to ensure consistency, impact, and momentum across the board.

You'll have the opportunity to solve technically and operationally complex problems at the intersection of global employment, payroll, compliance, automation, and AI, while helping shape how our Engineering organization operates as WorkMotion continues to grow. 

Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity…

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of software engineers, creating clear expectations and supporting their professional growth.
  • Own the team's delivery, execution, and engineering health, ensuring commitments are realistic and risks are identified early.
  • Partner closely with Product to translate business priorities into clear, executable technical plans.
  • Maintain strong technical awareness and actively participate in architecture, design, and engineering discussions.
  • Ensure appropriate engineering practices around code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and documentation.
  • Drive predictable delivery while balancing feature development, technical debt, scalability, and platform reliability.
  • Work with Principal and Senior Engineers on architecture and complex technical decisions.
  • Use engineering metrics and qualitative signals to continuously improve team effectiveness, quality, and delivery.
  • Identify dependencies and blockers early and coordinate effectively across teams.
  • Build a strong culture of ownership and accountability where engineers own their work from design through production.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and succession planning.
  • Contribute to broader Engineering initiatives and continuously improve how we build software at WorkMotion.

What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience, including experience building and operating production systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and the Java ecosystem, with the ability to understand, review, and challenge technical implementations and architectural decisions.
  • Proven experience leading or managing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to meaningfully contribute to architecture and technical discussions
  • Experience with modern software development practices, Java-based backend systems, cloud-native architectures, APIs, distributed systems, and CI/CD.
  • A strong understanding of software quality, automated testing, observability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Experience defining and using engineering effectiveness and delivery metrics, such as DORA metrics, flow metrics, quality and reliability indicators, to understand team health, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement—without using metrics as simplistic measures of individual performance.
  • Strong understanding of AI-assisted and agentic software development, with practical experience using modern AI coding tools and agents and the ability to help teams adopt them effectively across development, testing, code review, documentation, and other parts of the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Experience working closely with Product in an agile product-development environment.
  • Strong people-management skills, including coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.
  • The ability to turn ambiguous business requirements into structured execution plans.
  • A data-informed approach to engineering performance without reducing productivity to simplistic metrics.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Our Engineering Culture…

  • Ownership over hand-offs Teams own outcomes, not just tasks.
  • Quality with speed We move quickly without treating engineering quality as optional.
  • Pragmatism over perfection We make deliberate trade-offs based on business and technical context.
  • Transparency Risks, mistakes, and disagreements should surface early. 
  • Continuous improvement Our architecture, processes, and ways of working should get better as we scale.
  • Collaboration Great products come from Engineering, Product, Design, Security, Data, and business teams working together.

The Perks of Being Here…

  • Global, remote, and thriving:  We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.
  • Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day—a full day off just to recharge and relax.
  • Get fit and stay active: Whether it’s yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog—work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships.
  • Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you’ll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge. 
  • Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!
  • Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. 

*Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations. 

At WorkMotion, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team on ----- We’re here to support you every step of the way!

title: Werkstudent Strategie & Business Development (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at CKM Group
description_html:
Intro

Empfehlungsbonus!❤ Kennst du jemanden, der/die perfekt zu dieser Stelle passt? Dann empfiehl uns die Person. Startet deine Empfehlung erfolgreich dieses Werkstudium bei GreenMedical, erhältst du als Dankeschön einen 100-€ Wunschgutschein.*



Zur CKM Group gehören eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen sowie eine Klinik, die alle dazu beitragen, unserer Vision von einer gesünderen Welt näher zu kommen.  
Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo. 

Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist GreenMedical: Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service bieten wir einen einfachen und sicheren Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis, um Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität zu verbessern. Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Patienten bereits heute mit modernen Lösungen zur medizinisch begleiteten Gewichtsreduktion. Perspektivisch planen wir, unser Angebot um weitere Präventions- und Gesundheitsleistungen zu erweitern, um noch mehr Menschen individuell auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Gesundheit und Lebensqualität zu begleiten. 

Du willst im Venture Development durchstarten und konntest bereits erste Erfahrungen sammeln? Dann bewirb dich jetzt für ein Werkstudium und werde ein zentraler Akteur in der Entwicklung eines neuen HealthTech Ventures. Bringe deinen unternehmerischen Geist ein und hilf uns, innovativen Zugang zu Gesundheit zu ermöglichen.


Deine Mission bei uns

  • Markt-, Wettbewerbs- & Potenzialanalysen: Du führst Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Potenzialanalysen sowie Literatur- und Desk-Recherchen durch, identifizierst neue Wachstumsfelder und leitest daraus strategische Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
  • Geschäftsmodellentwicklung: Du wirkst an der Entwicklung und Validierung neuer Geschäftsmodelle mit und begleitest deren Weiterentwicklung bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Partnerschaften & Kooperationen: Du baust strategische Partnerschaften auf und entwickelst Kooperationen mit externen Stakeholdern strukturiert weiter.
  • Konzepte & Business Cases: Du bereitest Konzepte, Business Cases und Entscheidungsunterlagen adressatengerecht und überzeugend für interne und externe Stakeholder auf.
  • Projektsteuerung & Prozessentwicklung: Du analysierst Prozesse, strukturierst Anforderungen und steuerst Projekte eigenverantwortlich, um digitale Versorgungsangebote kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit & Eigenmotivation: Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Mindset, arbeitest proaktiv, übernimmst Verantwortung, denkst kreativ und bist bereit, für gute Ergebnisse die Extrameile zu gehen.
  • Analytisches & problemlösungsorientiertes Denken: Du kannst komplexe Fragestellungen strukturiert durchdringen, Kennzahlen und Business Cases aufbereiten sowie daraus fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.
  • Selbstständige & strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, sorgfältig und organisiert, behältst auch bei Unsicherheit, wechselnden Prioritäten oder mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick und gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an.
  • Kommunikation & Informationsverarbeitung: Du kannst neue Informationen schnell erfassen, kritisch einordnen und adressatengerecht aufbereiten. Zudem kommunizierst du klar, arbeitest gerne im Team und gehst offen sowie konstruktiv mit Feedback um.
  • PowerPoint & Excel: Du verfügst über einen sicheren Umgang mit PowerPoint und grundlegende Excel-Kenntnisse zur Analyse und Aufbereitung von Daten.
  • Interesse am Gesundheitsbereich: Du begeisterst dich für den Gesundheitsmarkt, digitale Innovationen und HealthTech und möchtest die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen aktiv mitgestalten.
  • Praktische Erfahrungen: Idealerweise hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im Business Development, Venture Development, HealthTech oder einem vergleichbaren dynamischen Umfeld gesammelt.
  • Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung: Bringe deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmen aktiv mit.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
  • 31 freie Tage: 30 Urlaubstage plus jeweils halbe Arbeitstage an Heiligabend und Silvester.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit DYNO: Eine provisionsfreie bAV-Lösung, damit mehr von deiner Altersvorsorge dort ankommt, wo sie hingehört – bei dir.
  • Wellpass: Zugang zu deutschlandweiten Sport-, Fitness- und Gesundheitsangeboten – von Fitnessstudios über Yoga und Schwimmen bis hin zu Massagen.
  • Probonio & Corporate Benefits: Über unsere Mitarbeiterplattform erhältst du Zugang zu attraktiven Vergünstigungen, exklusiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und zahlreichen Rabatten.
  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeiten im Herzen von Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg mit Blick auf die Spree und eigener Dachterrasse.


Du hast Fragen? Wir sind für dich da.

Unser People & Culture Team begleitet dich während des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses und steht dir jederzeit zur Seite. Wenn du Fragen hast oder etwas unklar ist, melde dich einfach bei unserem Recruiting-Team unter ----- – wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören!

*Teilnahmebedingungen:
Die Empfehlung muss durch die Bewerberin oder den Bewerber im Online-Bewerbungsformular von GreenMedical über das Feld „Hat dich jemand empfohlen?“ angegeben werden. Andere Meldewege werden nicht berücksichtigt. Bei der Nennung mehrerer Personen entfällt der Prämienanspruch.
Die Prämie wird nur gewährt, wenn die empfohlene Person eingestellt wird und das Praktikum tatsächlich antritt. Die empfehlende Person muss sich nach Praktikumsbeginn selbstständig bei GreenMedical melden.
Die Prämie besteht aus einem Wunschgutschein im Wert von 100 Euro. Eine Barauszahlung oder ein Umtausch sind ausgeschlossen. Etwaige steuerliche Pflichten trägt die empfangende Person.

Du hast Lust, im Tagesgeschäft eines wachsenden Unternehmens mit anzupacken, behältst auch bei vielen Themen gleichzeitig den Überblick und hast Spaß daran, sowohl im direkten Kundenkontakt als auch hinter den Kulissen für einen reibungslosen Ablauf zu sorgen? Dann unterstütze uns im Operations & Office Management im Rahmen eines 6-monatiges Praktikums!


Deine Mission bei uns

  • Support: Du bearbeitest, verfolgst nach und löst Support-Tickets unserer Kund:innen und behältst dabei stets einen freundlichen, lösungsorientierten Ton.
  • Reklamationsmanagement: Du entscheidest über Rückerstattungen und Reklamationen inkl. Kulanzentscheidungen und kommunizierst diese souverän per E-Mail und Telefon.
  • Dienstleistersteuerung: Du steuerst externe Dienstleister, sichtest und vergleichst Angebote und behältst dabei Kosten und Qualität im Blick.
  • Büromaterial & Ausstattung: Du kümmerst dich um Einkäufe für Büromaterial und -ausstattung und sorgst dafür, dass im Büro alles vorhanden ist, was das Team braucht.
  • Bürogestaltung: Du gestaltest und „eventisierst" unser Büro und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um daraus einen Ort zu machen, an dem sich das Team wohlfühlt.
  • Operations-Projekte: Du übernimmst projektbezogene Operations-Aufgaben und unterstützt so dabei, Unternehmen und Abteilung weiter voranzubringen.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Sprachen: Du kommunizierst stark und sicher, schriftlich wie mündlich – auf Deutsch (muttersprachlich) und Englisch (C1).
  • Organisationstalent: Du bist organisiert, behältst auch bei mehreren Themen gleichzeitig den Überblick und hast ein hohes Pflichtbewusstsein.
  • Auffassungsgabe: Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und findest dich zügig in neue Themen und Tools ein.
  • Kundenorientierung: Du bringst Kundenorientierung mit und behältst auch in herausfordernden Situationen einen kühlen Kopf.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Du hast technisches Verständnis und Interesse an digitalen Tools und Prozessen.

description_html:
Unser Angebot

Wir sind ein Unternehmen der Adragos Pharma Gruppe und produzieren an unserem Standort in Leipzig auf modernen Anlagen hochwertige Arzneimittel, Kosmetika und Nahrungsergänzungsprodukte. Wir bieten:
  • Ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet
  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege
  • 15 Tage Erholungsurlaub (bei 6 Monaten) und eine attraktive tarifliche Vergütung
  • Freistellung für den Besuch der begleitenden Unterrichtsveranstaltungen
  • Teilnahme am Sommer- und Weihnachtsfest, Firmenlauf und anderen Veranstaltungen


Deine Aufgaben

Im Rahmen des Praktikums übernimmst du unterschiedliche Aufgaben in den Bereichen Galenik, Herstellung, Qualitätskontrolle und der Qualitätssicherung. Du lernst über die Schnittstelle Qualitätssicherung alle GMP-relevanten Abläufe eines pharmazeutischen Unternehmens kennen und arbeiten aktiv an aktuellen, spannenden Schwerpunktthemen mit. Darüber hinaus erhältst du praktische Einblicke in die Herstellung, Verpackung und Prüfung von Arzneimitteln, Nahrungsergänzungsmittel, Kosmetika und Medizinprodukten. 
Hier kannst du mit deinem Uni-Wissen über analytische Chemie und instrumentelle Analytik z. B. HPLC, UV-VIS punkten und deine Kenntnisse praktisch erweitern. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Validierung von analytischen Methoden für den Bereich der Reinigungsvalidierung. In der Qualitätskontrolle führst du selbstständig Rohstoffanalytik nach dem Europäischen Arzneibuch, Fertigproduktanalytik und Stabilitätsprüfungen durch und dokumentierst deine Arbeit im Sinne der GMP. All das selbstständig und bestens von unseren erfahrenen Fachleuten betreut.


Dein Profil

Fachliche Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossenes Pharmaziestudium bzw. abgeschlossenes Zweites Staatsexamen
  • Bereitschaft, sich in qualitätsrelevante Prozesse, pharmazeutische Herstellung und regulatorische Anforderungen einzuarbeiten
  • Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Persönliche Anforderungen
  • Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Sorgfalt, Zuverlässigkeit und Termintreue
  • Analytisches Denken und Freude an Dokumentations- und Bewertungsaufgaben
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit
  • Eigenständige, verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Produktentwicklung, im Lieferanten- und Produktionsmanagement sowie in der Steuerung von Produkten über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus
  • Erfahrung in der Analyse von Preisen, Kosten, Margen, Wettbewerbern und Märkten sowie die Fähigkeit, daraus konkrete Produkt- und Geschäftsentscheidungen abzuleiten
  • Leidenschaft und fundierte Erfahrung im Go-to-Market- und Launch-Management sowie in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Produktkonzepte
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit und Verhandlung mit externen Lieferanten und Herstellern sowie im Management internationaler Partner
  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams sowie Freude daran, Mitarbeitende zu motivieren, weiterzuentwickeln und Verantwortung zu übertragen

title: Senior Programme Manager - EU Projects (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Submariner Network
description_html:
Your mission

For our growing project and service portfolio, we are looking for a senior staff member to:

  • Oversee and manage a portfolio of complex, multi-stakeholder EU-funded projects and service contracts with a focus on high-quality performance and compliance (incl. coordination of activities and tasks of project partners, monitoring of budgets, deliverable preparation, project reporting, etc).
  • Line manage, coordinate and guide staff members within that portfolio of projects and service contracts, including capacity management, performance appraisal and team development.
  • Position SUBMARINER/s.Pro strategically with regard to our different programmes within the field of blue innovations, capacity building and governance especially, but not exclusively under the EU Mission Ocean, EIT Water and DG MARE service contracts. 
  • Lead strategic stakeholder engagement activities within and beyond projects, including government agencies, industry partners, research and non-governmental organizations, to advance our impact across the Baltic and North Sea region and beyond.  
  • Author policy briefs, position papers, topical expert reports, and project deliverables.  
  • Represent the SUBMARINER Network/ s.Pro at workshops, conferences and events, including workshop facilitation and public speaking. 
  • Scout new project acquisition opportunities to advance our strategic objectives, including consortium building, strategic design thinking and proposal writing. 


Your profile

  • Relevant university degree at Master’s level, for example in an environmental / biomarine or social science discipline.
  • At least 7 years proven work experience in EU funding and policy and/or relevant industry sectors.
  • Proven experience in project/service acquisition at coordinator level, and proposal writing for EU projects.
  • Several years of experience in managing people and leading teams.
  • A strong network in the blue economy / sustainability field, and with EU institutions or other relevant stakeholders, is a distinct advantage.
  • Experience and or proven interest in the field of sustainability, environmental or marine topics (blue economy, blue skills and innovation, aquaculture, marine spatial planning or similar).
  • Evidence-based research and science-to-policy translation skills and the ability to produce high-quality reports, briefs and policy recommendations.
  • Skilled communicator with a proven ability to engage partners and donors diplomatically. Experienced in delivering impactful presentations to large audiences and facilitating workshops.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English. Proficiency in German and/or other languages of the Baltic Sea region is an advantage.
  • Good knowledge of MS Office, SharePoint and other collaboration tools.
  • Based in Berlin or willingness to relocate.
  • Able to travel occasionally in Europe to co-host or participate in events.
  • Please note that you must hold the right to live and work in Germany. No visa sponsorship for non-EU nationals can be offered.


Why us?

  • A meaningful job in a very dynamically evolving environment, where you contribute to restoring our Seas and Oceans and promoting a sustainable blue economy.
  • A job in full time (40 hours per week).
  • An interesting multicultural, international and diverse team.
  • Opportunity to travel within Europe for project meetings and events.
  • Possibility to develop your career within the organisation at a fast pace.
  • A beautiful loft office in Berlin.
  • Up to three home office days per week; flexible working hours and 28 days of holiday annually.
  • Regular overall team retreats to promote internal knowledge transfer, generate shared ideas and strengthen the working atmosphere.

description_html:
Position

Do you have a clear ambition to shape IT procurement and existing IT spend in a way that optimizes demand, specifications, and commercial models, resulting in P&L-relevant savings? And would like to become part of our IT Value Creation Team?

Then we have exactly the right role for you:

(SENIOR) EXPERT SOFTWARE SOURCING & VALUE CREATION

Start date flexible, permanent position, during the week project-related at our clients’ sites, and typically on Fridays in our offices in Munich, Cologne, or Hamburg


Your mission

  • In this role, you analyze our clients’ existing software spend, license inventories, and contract structures, deriving concrete savings potential
  • You prepare complex new procurements and contract renewals with enterprise software and SaaS providers such as SAP, Microsoft, Oracle, Salesforce, Adobe, ServiceNow, or comparable vendors
  • Together with IT, business departments, and program leads, you critically challenge requirements, user groups, license types, modules, add-ons, roll-out plans, and growth assumptions
  • A key part of your work is developing target volumes, licensing and contract models, as well as negotiation strategies for renewals and new procurements
  • You assess license metrics, entitlements, usage rights, edition logic, and contractual mechanisms such as minimum commitments, price increases, true-ups, audit rights, termination periods, and contract terms
  • Working closely with our procurement experts, you translate business and technical requirements into commercially sound sourcing decisions
  • You prepare workshops, lead discussions with clients, and structure decision-making for IT, business departments, procurement, and management
  • Your work also includes supporting the implementation of measures such as downsizing, reharvesting, cleaning up unused licenses, adjusting license editions, or avoiding unnecessary commitments
  • Beyond client work, you further develop our expertise in Software Sourcing & Commercial Value and actively share your knowledge with colleagues


Your profile

  • A completed degree, ideally in business informatics, business administration, computer science, industrial engineering, or a comparable field
  • At least five years of professional experience in software procurement, IT vendor management, software asset management, license consulting, IT sourcing, IT commercial management, or a comparable environment
  • Practical experience with enterprise software and SaaS contracts, particularly in renewals, new procurements, contract optimization, or license clean-up
  • A solid understanding of license metrics, subscriptions, entitlements, usage rights, edition and pricing models, as well as typical contractual clauses

  • Experience in leading workshops, structuring complex issues, and collaborating with different stakeholder groups

  • Fluent German and English skills, both written and spoken

description_html:
Your mission

We are looking for an experienced Technical Product Owner to take ownership of our C++ SDK, which forms the core of our software platform and serves as the foundation for the majority of our engineering work, products, and customer projects.

You will shape the product direction, roadmap, priorities, and release process while working closely with software engineers, our Lead Architect, product teams, and business stakeholders.

The role is designed to grow into functional and people leadership responsibility for engineers working on the C++ SDK and ImFusion Suite.


Your responsibilities

  • Own and continuously develop product vision, roadmap, backlog, and prioritization for our C++ SDK & ImFusion Suite

  • Align C++ SDK and ImFusion Suite roadmap with our wider company and platform strategy 

  • Bring together requirements from customers, internal users, product teams, engineering, and management and translate them into clear priorities.

  • Coordinate development activities and releases across teams and components, ensuring that individual efforts contribute to a coherent product.

  • Manage timelines, dependencies, risks, capacity, and technical trade-offs.

  • Balance short-term delivery needs with technical quality and the long-term development of the product.

  • Drive resource planning, support team growth, and gradually take on functional and people leadership.


Who you are

  • You are a systems thinker who can understand a complex technical ecosystem, connect the individual pieces, and maintain sight of the bigger picture.

  • You combine genuine technical curiosity with a strong product mindset and a desire to create impact beyond implementation.

  • You bring clarity and structure to ambiguous situations without oversimplifying technical complexity.

  • You listen to different perspectives but are comfortable challenging assumptions, setting boundaries, and saying no when necessary—regardless of seniority or role.

  • You communicate confidently with engineers, scientists, product teams, customers, and management and build trust across these groups.

  • You take ownership, follow through, and proactively address risks and obstacles.

  • You lead through trust, constructive feedback, sound judgement, and a genuine interest in helping others grow.


Your profile

  • Several years of experience as a software engineer, giving you a solid understanding of programming and software development.

  • Subsequent experience owning or coordinating a technically complex software product, platform, or large-scale engineering initiative.

  • Experience developing roadmaps, managing requirements, setting priorities, and coordinating delivery across multiple teams and stakeholders.

  • Experience coordinating, mentoring, or enabling software engineers; previous formal leadership experience is a plus. 

  • A strong understanding of APIs, software architecture, testing, technical debt, maintainability, versioning, and backwards compatibility.

  • Experience with capacity and resource planning, including translating roadmap needs into staffing or hiring requirements.

  • Hands-on experience adapting SDK requirements, architecture, and product roadmaps to advances in AI.

Nice to have

  • Experience with C++ development or ownership of a C++-based product or platform.

  • Experience with developer-facing products or SDKs.

  • A background in medical imaging, computer vision, or another technically complex software domain.

  • Ideally, you are based in Munich or the surrounding area and enjoy working regularly from our Munich office, allowing you to connect with key stakeholders in person.


Why us?

  • Shape foundational technologies used across our products and customer projects.

  • Work closely with experienced engineers, architects, and product teams.

  • Take on significant ownership and grow into functional and people leadership.

  • Work on challenging software at the intersection of medical imaging, computer vision, and AI.

  • Benefit from flexible working arrangements and a collaborative environment.

The stated salary range includes a discretionary, performance-based bonus.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at exmox
description_html:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.

As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.

  • Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.

  • Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

  • Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.

  • Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.


What You Bring

  • Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.

  • Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.

  • Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

  • Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.

  • High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

  • Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.

  • Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, building high-performing consumer products in mobile gaming. We're scaling a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players, and here, data isn't just analyzed, it's turned into systems that directly drive business performance.

As a Senior AI-Native Data Engineer (f/m/x), you'll operate at the intersection of data, engineering, and product, building and scaling the data foundation that powers our entire business. This isn't a role for maintaining pipelines or following predefined processes, we look for engineering mindset and entrepreneurial ownership: you build it, you own it, and you see the impact in production. AI is not a side tool here, it's core to how you work: you'll use Claude and similar AI tools daily to plan, build, debug, and document, including managing context and memory across projects, integrating AI directly into your version control workflow, and running parallel agent workflows on separate tasks, cutting repetitive tasks so you can focus where it actually moves the needle.

We believe a small team of engineers working closely with AI can outperform a much larger traditional data team, and we're building this role around that belief, not around AI as an occasional convenience.

If you're excited by complex systems, high traffic, and data-driven decisions, and impact matters more to you than process, we want to hear from you. We use AI for everything in order to improve speed and quality.

What You’ll Own:

  • Data Pipelines & Integration: You design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL pipelines on Databricks to integrate data from various sources, including app and web products and marketing partner data, ensuring reliable and efficient data flow across the business.

  • Data Lakehouse Ownership: You build and manage the Data Lakehouse on Databricks, including migrating legacy data products, and implement data transformations and processing logic using Databricks and PySpark.

  • Monitoring & Optimization: You monitor and maintain the data stack for nightly and near-real-time processing of in-house tracking solutions, continuously optimizing and troubleshooting pipelines to ensure data quality and integrity.

Your profile

  • Background: Background in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related discipline, with an interest in marketing data, tracking systems, and campaign attribution.
  •  Product Feeds: Basic understanding of product feed structures; experience with tools like ProductsUp is a plus.

  • Advertising Platforms: Familiarity with platforms such as Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads, or TikTok (hands-on experience is a plus).
  • Data & Reporting: experience working with Excel or Google Sheets; understanding of simple data handling and reporting. 
  • Automation & AI Tools: Interest in tools such as ChatGPT, Make.com, or Google Sheets automation; no advanced experience required. 
  • Analytical Mindset: Curious and detail-oriented, with a willingness to learn how data supports marketing decisions. 
  • Communication & Collaboration: Able to communicate clearly, ask questions, and work effectively within a team. 
  • Working Style: Structured, proactive, and eager to develop technical and analytical skills. 
  • Languages: Fluent in English (spoken and written); German is a plus but not required.


Your Extra

  • Your Growth & Development: Access to certifications, 360° feedback, and salary progression. Real opportunities to grow together with your team and the company.

Short title

Build brand communities on social media


Introduction

You don't just manage social media, you shape how brands show up on it. As a Senior Social Media Manager at Pulse Advertising, you lead multi-platform strategies for global brand accounts, drive creative direction, and set the standard for platform-native excellence. You know what's about to peak on TikTok before it peaks, and you're as strong creatively as you are strategically, ideating concepts in a client workshop and owning their execution the next day. You're a trusted senior partner to clients and a go-to voice internally, someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just outputs. If you're ready to lead at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and impact, this is your next chapter.


Your tasks

  • You own TikTok-first content strategies for key global brand accounts, defining platform-native formats, content pillars, and creative direction that drive measurable engagement and business results

  • You lead content planning and execution across TikTok, Reels, Stories, and complementary formats, ensuring every channel feels native, intentional, and on-brand

  • You manage social media across multiple brands within a single parent account, adapting global content frameworks for regional markets with a particular focus on DACH

  • You act as a senior client partner, steering projects from briefing to delivery, proactively shaping agendas and challenging briefs that don't align with platform or audience reality

  • You track, synthesise, and present performance data, translating complex analytics into sharp client-ready insights and actionable recommendations

  • You mentor junior and mid-level team members and contribute to pitches and new business proposals, bringing your platform expertise to grow both the team and the account base


Your skills

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in social media management with a clear TikTok focus, including proven results across global or multi-market brand accounts- ideally in consumer goods, home appliances, or lifestyle hardware

  • You think in TikTok: trend cycles, FYP mechanics, algorithm behaviour, and the instinct to know what feels native versus what kills engagement

  • You are comfortable operating within multi-brand account structures and familiar with global-to-local content models, managing competing brand identities across markets without losing quality or speed

  • You are a hands-on creative with the ability to concept campaign ideas and translate them into platform-native formats that resonate with audiences and impress clients

  • You are experienced with Canva, video editing tools, and social analytics platforms and actively use AI tooling to scale your work

  • You are confident leading senior client relationships, communicating platform logic clearly, managing expectations and influencing decisions at stakeholder level.

  • You are fluent in both German and English 


Our Benefits

  • Time to pack your bags for Paris, London, Milan, Hamburg or Berlin: you’re welcome to work abroad from any of our office locations

  • We love to see you grow: our careers coach is on hand for one-to-one coaching sessions and team workshops

  • We work hard and play hard, bringing our global team together to collaborate, learn from one another and celebrate our successes

  • Don’t fancy the office today? Our hybrid remote policy lets you work from home two days a week

  • Keep your commute to a minimum: you’ll find all our offices right in the city centre

  • For motivational high-paws and comforting cuddles, your four-legged friend is absolutely welcome at our offices

title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Duck Duck Go
description_html:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Site Reliability Team, you'll help build and maintain world-class infrastructure to meet the needs of millions of users protecting their privacy online. You'll utilize high-level languages like Perl, Go, TypeScript, or Python and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Ensuring our Duck.ai product meets our reliability standards and minimizing user friction on failures

  • Scaling up our own index infrastructure to handle billions of documents

  • Create anti fraud verifications that respect users privacy

 

As Director, Site Reliability Engineering, you'll dive deep into complex operational challenges, including software, systems, automation, and process analysis. We are looking for candidates who can read, write, troubleshoot, and deploy all types of software to help us tackle the reliability challenges of large-scale deployments.

 

About You

  • 10+ years relevant professional experience in reliability, platform, infrastructure, or software engineering, including 4+ years leading SRE teams.

  • Experience participating in a 24x7 on-call rotation for a large-scale deployment.

  • Ability to lead and collaborate on high-impact and complex projects from proposal through postmortem.

  • Proficient in AI-driven development, including designing and implementing agentic workflows

  • Skills to wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a strong focus on metrics.

  • Experience developing effective tools, services, alerts, and responses to identify and address reliability risks.

  • Investigative ability to root-cause sources of instability in high-traffic, distributed systems.

  • Deep experience administering and troubleshooting Linux and web technologies.

  • Ability to implement automation around infrastructure provisioning and configuration management to prioritize efficiency, scalability, and reliability.

  • Foresight to help identify the future technical direction of our deployment with the goal of improving reliability and performance.

  • Advanced programming skills enabling close partnership with software engineers to triage production issues and identify appropriate remediation, including code changes and performance considerations.

  • Ability to leverage cloud-native services and architectures to enhance reliability and scalability, with hands-on experience packaging and deploying applications using Docker and Docker Compose.

Compensation

$243,800 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

 

Please note that:

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

 

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

  • Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

  • Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at

title: Senior Product Designer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Didomi
description_html:
Senior Product Designer

Didomi is looking for a Senior Product Designer to take end-to-end ownership of design across multiple products within our Privacy and Consent Management Platform. This is a senior IC role reporting directly to the Design Director, acting as design peer-lead within the Product team, supporting seven Product Managers and their engineering teams. Design is currently the one shared resource across the entire product org, and this role is central to how we scale it.

You'll help shape the future of our product, creating experiences that are intuitive, efficient, and user-centric, while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners. You'll get involved early, shaping problems alongside Product and Engineering rather than just executing against requirements handed to you, and take ownership of your workstreams once scope is assigned based on where the business needs it most.

What you'll do

  • Own the process end-to-end. Lead discovery through delivery for your assigned product areas, handing off finalized UX/functional design to our external creative agency for UI polish.
  • Shape decisions upstream. Get involved before requirements are locked, and bring evidence and clear rationale to engineering-first decisions rather than reacting after the fact.
  • Take ownership across ambiguity. Hold multiple complex workstreams and adapt as scope shifts with business priorities.
  • Build the research muscle. Help establish research and usability practices that don't fully exist today, and translate findings into decisions Product and Engineering can act on.
  • Reduce design debt. Flag and help prevent downstream friction from features shipping without a design pass.
  • Prototype fast with AI. Use tools like Figma Make or Claude to turn concepts into high-level, testable prototypes quickly, helping the team validate direction and unblock decisions without waiting on full design cycles for every idea.
  • Foster a strong design culture. Share knowledge, mentor peers, and help improve team processes.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in product/UX design, with real ownership of complex products and a strong portfolio of shipped work.
  • Fluency in Figma or equivalent design/prototyping tools.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments with limited day-to-day oversight.
  • Strong interaction and systems thinking. You can untangle complex flows and design for edge cases.
  • Experience building or contributing to a research practice where formal resourcing is limited.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work efficiently with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience designing zero-to-one products, new platforms, or defining new product spaces.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (Figma Make, Claude, or similar) to generate high-level prototypes and accelerate concept validation.

Strongly preferred: experience in privacy, compliance, or another highly regulated/technical domain.

We don't expect candidates to meet every point above. If most of this resonates, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll bring

TBC
