description_html:
At Klim, we work with farmers and food companies to make regenerative agriculture scalable and financially rewarding for farmers. Through our platform, we help farmers restore soil health, increase biodiversity and capture carbon while creating new, reliable income streams.


We’re a Berlin-based AgriTech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and Kaufland to reduce emissions across their supply chains and build long-term resilience. Since 2020, we’ve supported 3,500 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

If you’re passionate about building a sustainable food system and driving real climate impact, join us and help create a healthier planet!

Your mission:

You are responsible for translating regenerative agricultural expertise and science in arable farming systems in temperate climates into actionable, scalable digital products for farmers on Klim's platform.

You ensure that Klim’s digital products are agronomically sound, farmer-relevant, commercially viable and delivered with high quality.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own the agronomic logic behind farmer-facing recommendation and assessment engines.

  • Translate agronomic principles into digital products and clear product and engineering specifications.

  • Own and evolve digital agronomy products, including digital decision-support and assessment tools for farmers

  • Expand Klim’s capabilities for regenerative practices in temperate arable systems, including method prioritization, trade-off assessment, and scientific evidence integration.

  • Own and review agronomic datasets, literature, and assumptions used in digital products.

  • Contribute to roadmap and prioritization decisions based on farmer value, willingness to pay, partner value, technical feasibility, and strategic relevance.

  • Validate agronomic models, algorithms, and prototypes by challenging assumptions, stress-testing outputs against field reality, and approving agronomic soundness before release.

  • Support farmer validation through interviews, feedback analysis, test cases, and field-reality checks.

  • Monitor competitors and support expansion into new markets, geographies, and climate zones.

  • Serve as the internal expert on regenerative arable farming, supporting Product, Sales, Farmer Success, Marketing, Data, and Remote Sensing teams.

  • Review agronomic content, farmer-facing explanations, and English/German copy for accuracy and credibility.

Depending on your experience, profile, skills and Klim’s team setup, this role may also include an Agronomy Team Lead scope with responsibility for managing the agronomy team.

  • Manage the agronomy team, translating strategic projects into execution

  • Review team outputs and ensure high standards of agronomic quality, scientific robustness and farmer relevance.

Your profile:

Agronomic Experience

  • You have 5+ years of experience in agronomy, regenerative agriculture, farm advisory, agricultural science, or a related field.

  • You have strong practical experience working with arable farms through farm management, agronomic advisory, or farmer-facing research.

  • You have a solid academic background in agronomy, agricultural sciences, or a related discipline.

  • You have a deep understanding of regenerative arable farming in temperate climates, including soil health, nutrient management, crop rotations, cover crops, tillage, and reduced-input systems.

Skills

  • You can translate agronomic expertise into scalable digital products and critically assess models, algorithms, and recommendations.

  • You exercise strong judgement and can develop solutions in ambiguous or novel situations.

  • You are pragmatic, innovative, and motivated to create scalable value for farmers.

  • You are an effective communicator and collaborator across functions.

  • You have an interest in mentoring or team leadership (a plus, not a requirement).

  • You are comfortable using AI tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high-quality standards.

Languages

  • You are fluent in English; German is a strong advantage.

Your benefits:

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

  • Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

  • Flexible work model: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly.

  • Additional benefits for Germany-based employees: We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket, a company pension scheme, plus team lunches (if based in Berlin) and regular team events.

At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for our team in ways you don’t yet realise!

title: Senior Account Executive and Partnership Manager (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Klim
description_html:
At Klim, we work with farmers and businesses to make regenerative agriculture a scalable and economically viable part of the food system. As a German AgriTech company, we empower farmers in improving soil health, increasing biodiversity, and capturing carbon, while generating reliable income through our platform.

Backed by €22 million in Series A funding, we are scaling our impact internationally and partnering with clients from the food and non-food industry. Since 2020, we have worked with more than 4,000 farmers across 900,000 hectares, covering more than 5% of Germany’s agricultural land.

If you are motivated by building a more sustainable food system and contributing to measurable climate impact, Klim offers the opportunity to do so at scale.

Your mission

As part of Klim's Business Development Team within the Commercial team, you will scale our reach by building and deepening relationships with marketplaces, intermediaries, brokers, and distribution partners. You will drive revenue by developing the channels through which Klim's carbon credits reach buyers at scale and help bring carbon credits to market. This includes designing partnership structures, onboarding intermediaries, and enabling them to represent and sell Klim's offerings with confidence to buyers. This role is for someone who understands that the most durable commercial impact comes from building the right ecosystems, not just closing individual deals.

If you enjoy working in fast-moving environments, value thoughtful, consultative sales and want your work to contribute to real-world change, we are happy to hear from you.

Your responsibilities

  • Own and grow a high-value partnership pipeline, from first and ongoing conversations to contract signature and sales enablement with a variety of partners ranging from start-ups to established carbon credit marketplaces. We are looking at success measures activation of partners and sourced revenue via partnerships.

  • Research, structure, carry-out and review a partnership strategy to engage qualified and new market segments. Understand and communicate successes, risks, and mitigations transparent to management through optimized reporting and utilization of our CRM.

  • Lead structured discovery conversations to understand prospective client needs, decision criteria and internal stakeholder dynamics to present offerings that position Klim as a strategic solution provider for clients’ sustainability, ESG and climate strategies.

  • Identify, evaluate and onboard marketplace partners and distribution channels (e.g. sustainability platforms, brokers, consultancies, ESG solution providers) that can scale Klim's reach into new buyer segments.

  • Lead joint business planning conversations with partners to align on value propositions, go-to-market approaches, integration requirements and shared success metrics.

  • Design and maintain a partner enablement program, providing marketplace partners and intermediaries with the materials, training and tools needed to represent Klim's offerings effectively and compliantly.

  • Collaborate closely with finance, certification, marketing and product to ensure seamless handovers and strong client outcomes.

  • Track and monitor key sales metrics through diligent CRM maintenance, track market trends in an independent way and gather client feedback proactively to optimise individual and team sales performance.

  • Stay on top of developments in carbon markets, standards, and regulation (e.g. SBTi, Verra, CCP, CRCF) to inform conversations and sharpen positioning.

  • Represent Klim at industry events, conferences and sustainability forums to expand your network and generate new leads.

Your profile

  • Business-ready fluency in English is a must. A upper intermediate level of German (B2) is a plus.

  • At least three years of experience in a quota-carrying partnership management or sales role, with full responsibility for closing deals.

  • Demonstrated track record of building and scaling partnership channels or marketplace relationships — from identifying and structuring agreements to activating and growing them over time.

  • Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder relationships with partners and intermediaries, paired with strong account management skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholder groups.

  • A proven track record of managing the full sales funnel end to end, with confidence in handling six-figure deals and maintaining strong CRM discipline, including accurate opportunity stages and clearly documented next steps.

  • General working knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies (preferably MEDDPICC) and the ability to run structured pipeline reviews, clearly articulating blockers, risks and decision paths across multiple active opportunities.

  • Experience drafting, tailoring and optimising presentations and other materials for client-facing and internal use; advanced proficiency with Google Workspace or comparable tools is required.

  • A collaborative, people-oriented mindset: you enjoy working closely with colleagues across teams and contributing to a positive, mission-driven culture.

  • Motivation to contribute to Klim’s mission of accelerating the transition to regenerative agriculture, and a belief that commercial excellence is a key lever for real-world impact.

  • A plus: experience in carbon markets and environmental policy, including voluntary carbon markets, pricing dynamics, and relevant standards and frameworks.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation: We offer an attractive base salary plus uncapped commission on partner-sourced revenue. Commission is structured around partner activation and revenue growth, rewarding you for building a channel that performs at scale.

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

  • Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

  • Additional benefits for full time, Germany based employees: We offer membership in the Urban Sports Club or subsidisation of the Deutschlandticket, contribution to a company pension scheme, plus team lunches and regular team events.

At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all.

title: C005419 Senior Project Transition Manager (NS) - MON 5 Oct
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Emw
description_html:
Deadline Date: Monday 5 October 2026

Requirement: Senior Project Transition Manager

Location: Wiesbaden, DE

Full Time On-Site: Yes

Time On-Site: 100%

Total Scope of the request (hours): 350

Required Start Date: 10 November 2026

End Contract Date: 23 December 2026

Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET

 

Duties & Role: 

Project Transition to Operations

  • Leads the transition of projects and capabilities into operational service, from early engagement in project planning through to formal handover and early life support.
  • Defines and agrees transition plans, entry and exit criteria, service acceptance criteria and handover deliverables with Project Managers, Service Owners and customers.
  • Ensures operational readiness prior to go-live: support model, staffing, training, documentation, spares, underpinning contracts, monitoring and configuration data are in place.
  • Evaluates project outputs against agreed service acceptance criteria and formally recommends acceptance, conditional acceptance or rejection.
  • Identifies, manages and escalates transition risks, issues and dependencies, and ensures residual risks are understood and owned by operations.
  • Manages early life support and closes transition only when agreed service performance has been demonstrated.
  • Captures and applies lessons identified to improve future transitions.

Local Operations Management (Wiesbaden)

  • Takes accountability for the day-to-day delivery of NCIA services at the location, including service performance, customer satisfaction and compliance with security and safety requirements.
  • Leads and coordinates local technical, support and contractor personnel, setting clear priorities, standards and direction.
  • Oversees the local infrastructure (facilities, networks, data centre / server rooms, end-user and deployable CIS assets) and ensures it is maintained, secured and fit for purpose.
  • Ensures asset and configuration management records for the location are accurate and complete.
  • Coordinates local business continuity and service recovery arrangements.

Incident and Problem Management

  • Ensures incidents are logged, prioritised, diagnosed and resolved according to agreed procedures and service levels.
  • Leads the resolution of major incidents, coordinating technical teams, vendors and customers, and provides timely, accurate communication to senior stakeholders.
  • Escalates unresolved incidents and facilitates recovery following resolution.
  • Initiates and monitors problem investigations, drives root cause analysis and ensures preventive measures are implemented.
  • Analyses incident and problem trends to reduce recurrence and improve service stability.

Change Management

  • Manages the change control process for services and assets at the location and for services in transition.
  • Assesses changes for risk, impact, cost and resource requirements, and represents the location in Change Advisory Boards.
  • Ensures changes are planned, communicated, tested, implemented and reviewed in a controlled manner, minimizing disruption to operations.

Service Level Management

  • Negotiates service level requirements and agreed service levels with customers, and contributes to Service Level Agreements, Operational Level Agreements and underpinning contracts.
  • Monitors service performance and key performance indicators, diagnoses service delivery problems and initiates improvement actions.
  • Provides accurate and regular performance reporting to NCIA management and customers.
  • Drives continual service improvement across processes, tools and third-party delivery.

Cost, Resource and Vendor Management

  • Manages the operational and transition budget for the location, including cost planning, forecasting, tracking and variance reporting.
  • Provides inputs to customer budget processes, cost models and service rates, ensuring the full cost of operating transitioned services is identified and funded.
  • Identifies cost optimisation opportunities without compromising service levels or security.
  • Manages vendor and contractor performance against contractual obligations, statements of work and service levels, and supports procurement activities as required.

 

Specific Working Conditions: Occasional travel within NATO nations, including to operational sites, may be required.

Requirements

Skills, Knowledge & Experience:

  • The candidate must have a currently active NATO SECRET security clearance
  • A minimum requirement of a Bachelor's degree at a nationally recognised/certified university in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline, and 8 years' post-related experience.
  • Or exceptionally, the lack of a university degree may be compensated by the demonstration of a candidate's particular abilities or experience that is/are of interest to the NCI Agency, that is, at least 12 years' extensive and progressive expertise in duties related to the function of the post.
  • Minimum 8 years of combined experience in IT service management and project management, of which at least 3 years in a senior role.
  • Proven experience (minimum 5 years) in IT service management in a Service Delivery Manager, IT Operations Manager or similar role, including incident, problem, change and service level management.
  • Proven experience (minimum 5 years) in project management, delivering complex IT/CIS projects to time, cost and quality.
  • Demonstrable track record of transitioning projects or new capabilities into live operational service.
  • Proven experience engaging, influencing and briefing senior stakeholders at executive (C-level) or General/Flag Officer level.
  • Experience managing IT infrastructure (networks, data centres, servers, end-user and communications systems) in an operational environment.
  • Experience in budget and cost management, including forecasting, cost control and financial reporting.
  • Proven experience managing vendors and contractors against contractual and service level obligations.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams in an international environment.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions under pressure.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation (or ITIL v3 Foundation).
  • Project management certification: PMP (PMI / PMBOK) or PRINCE2 Practitioner.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience in NATO, military, defence or other international organisations.
  • Experience with deployable CIS or mission-critical communications services.
  • ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader; MSP or PgMP; SIAM certification.
  • Experience with ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management).
  • Knowledge of NATO procurement and financial processes.
  • Working knowledge of German.

title: Solution Architect – Client Solutions (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Fincite Gmbh
description_html:
Deine Herausforderungen

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unseren Entwicklungsteams und verbringst einen wesentlichen Teil deiner Zeit im direkten Austausch mit Kunden.
  • Du hörst genau hin, verstehst die Kundenprobleme und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Fragestellungen, die unsere Entwickler konkret bearbeiten können.
  • Auf Basis deines tiefen technischen Hintergrunds entwickelst du Lösungsarchitekturen, die sowohl zu den Anforderungen des Kunden als auch zu unserer eigenen Systemlandschaft passen.
  • Dabei denkst du in Systemen: Du verstehst unsere Architektur, die technische Umgebung unserer Kunden, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten und kannst diese Welten sinnvoll zusammenbringen.
  • Bei APIs und Integrationen kannst du nicht nur Anforderungen formulieren, sondern auch auf technischer Ebene mit unseren Entwicklern über Lösungswege und deren Auswirkungen diskutieren.
  • Du begleitest Projekte von der ersten Anforderung bis zur Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten technischen Idee auch eine funktionierende Lösung wird.
  • Als Bindeglied zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Engineering sorgst du für Klarheit: Was ist das eigentliche Problem? Was brauchen wir technisch? Was ist sinnvoll umsetzbar?
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Themen, koordinierst unterschiedliche Stakeholder und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick.


Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, Product Management, Softwareentwicklung oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Business und Technologie.
  • Ein gutes technisches Verständnis für Softwarearchitekturen, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und API-Design. Ein Entwicklerhintergrund ist dabei ein klarer Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und die Fähigkeit, Kundenprobleme und fachliche Anforderungen wirklich zu verstehen und in klare, umsetzbare technische Anforderungen zu übersetzen.
  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering: Du kannst technische Themen auf Augenhöhe diskutieren, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln und gemeinsam mit Entwicklern pragmatische Lösungen entwickeln.
  • Interesse an Wealth Management, Finanztechnologie und SaaS sowie die Bereitschaft, dich tief in fachliche und technische Zusammenhänge einzuarbeiten.
  • Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden, ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zusammenzubringen und Lösungen strukturiert bis in die Umsetzung zu begleiten.


Unser Angebot

Wir sind ein etabliertes Produktunternehmen mit dem Spirit eines Startups. Dich erwarten Teamgeist, schnelle Entscheidungen und echte Freiheit, dein Arbeitsumfeld zu gestalten. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Weiterbildungsbudgets und attraktive Benefits geben dir Raum für persönliche Entwicklung, Karrieremöglichkeiten und ein erfülltes Leben.


Sprachkenntnisse

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau 
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Ansprechpartner/in

Julian Eder

teamHOLDING GmbH

  • Unterstützung in der Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung, sowie der Monatssteuer

Zur teamHOLDING GmbH gehören unter anderem: teamZUKUNFT gGmbH – freier Träger der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe sowie Programmanbieter für Klassenfahrten und Feriencamps, teamEXPERTE GmbH – erlebnispädagogische Outdoor- und Teamtrainings sowie Aus- und Weiterbildung, teamJUGENDHERBERGEN GmbH – eigene Programmhäuser wie die Jugendherberge Hilchenbach sowie teamSERVICE GmbH – Hausmeister- und Facility-Services. 

Was uns verbindet: Wir schaffen Räume, in denen Menschen wachsen – mit Herz, Haltung und einem starken Team.

title: Security Research Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Artemis
description_html:
Artemis is building the future of AI-driven defense - helping companies detect and defend themselves effectively in an era where AI is fighting AI on the cyber battlefield.

We’re backed by First Round Capital, Brightmind, and a group of the cybersecurity industry’s most prominent Operators.

Our founders, Shachar (ex-Palo Alto Networks, AWS, Demisto) and Dan (ex-Abnormal Security, Twitter) have previously built, launched, and scaled cybersecurity products loved and trusted by tens of thousands of customers, and have the customer, technology, and security know-hows to deliver this vision.

Our exceptionally strong team includes software engineers, AI researchers, security engineers, and product designers hailing from Google, Abnormal AI, Wiz, Meta, AWS, CERN, SentinelOne, and more.

We are growing our team and looking for passionate builders to join us and support our expanding customer base.

Job Overview

We're looking for a Security Research Engineer to drive detection research, threat hunting, and AI-powered security automation. You'll work at the intersection of security expertise and cutting-edge AI—researching data sources, building detections, investigating real incidents, and engaging directly with customers to deliver security value. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where your work directly shapes what threats we catch and how we catch them.

Responsibilities

  • Develop AI-powered detection tooling - Build automation that leverages AI to accelerate detection creation, tuning, and validation at scale.

  • Conduct security research - Analyze cloud, identity, and SaaS data sources (AWS CloudTrail, Okta, Entra ID, and more) to extract security value and identify detection opportunities.

  • Perform attack simulations - Execute authorized attack simulations to validate detection coverage and identify gaps in our defenses.

  • Hunt for threats - Proactively search for malicious activity across customer environments using our platform and tooling.

  • Investigate potential cases - Analyze security incidents to demonstrate product value, refine detection logic, and deliver actionable findings.

  • Engage with customers - Join customer calls to present analysis results, walk through findings, and gather feedback that shapes the product.

  • Tune customer detections - Reduce false positives and improve detection accuracy based on real-world data and customer context.

  • Build investigation automation - Create AI-powered tools that scale investigation and threat hunting workflows across our platform.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience

  • Hands-on experience in incident response including cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and identity providers (Okta, Entra ID)

  • Strong knowledge of threat actor tactics, techniques, & procedures and demonstrated understanding uncovering threat actor activity in various environments

  • Strong experience with log-based analysis and demonstrated ability to identify malicious activity across a variety of log sources

  • Ability to translate security research into actionable detections or threat hunt investigations

  • Strong communication skills—comfortable explaining technical findings to engineers and customers

  • Experience with detection engineering at scale

  • Bonus:

    • Background working in a SOC environment or Managed Detection and Response.

    • Familiarity with a wide range of security tools (SIEM, EDR, SOAR)

    • Customer-facing technical experience

    • Experience with AI tools and models

Why Work at Artemis?

  • Make a real world impact. Help empower cybersecurity teams around the world to keep people safe from the most advanced cyber threats.

  • Be challenged to be better than ever before. Our team includes some of the smartest and most driven people in the world. We guarantee you will learn more in 1 year here than 10 years in another place.

  • Push the boundaries of technology. Work with and build the most advanced AI capabilities in the world of cybersecurity, including cutting-edge analytics and agentic platforms. Your ideas will shape the product and the industry.

  • Innovative culture. We obsess about customers, move fast with high quality, and value open communication, mentorship and learning. You will have autonomy to drive projects and support to grow.If you are passionate about building resilient distributed systems and want to apply your expertise to defend against AI‑powered adversaries, we’d love to hear from you.

    If you are passionate about cybersecurity and want to apply your expertise to build AI-powered defenses against advanced threats, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation
We offer a competitive compensation of 160,000$- 190,000$ per year, and a top-of-market equity component. A variety of factors are considered when determining the compensation, including a candidate’s professional experience. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed.

Equal Opportunity
At Artemis, we believe the best ideas come from diverse teams. We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can do their best work. We welcome everyone, regardless of race, gender, age, religion, identity, or anything else that makes you, you.

description_html:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous :

En tant que post-doctorant.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au Centre de Formation et de Recherche CMP qui est situé à Gardanne (dans les Bouches-du-Rhône, 13). Il est l’un des cinq centres de formation et de recherche de l’Ecole. Il comprend quatre départements de recherche dont le département d’Electronique Flexible (FEL) au sein duquel le poste de postdoctorant est ouvert. Le département FEL compte 25 personnes, dont 7 enseignants-chercheurs, 1 ingénieur et 15 chercheurs postdoctoraux et doctorants.

La mission porte sur le développement d’une batterie biodégradable au sodium pour dispositifs médicaux temporaires.

Le système sera entièrement composé de matériaux biorésorbables, avec une durée de vie ajustable. Les performances seront évaluées in vivo, incluant la stabilité électrochimique et la recharge sans fil. Cette recherche offrira une solution plus sûre pour alimenter les implants médicaux de courte durée.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons :

Vous êtes titulaire d’un Doctorat, en recherche d’un Post-Doc.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

·           Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

·           Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

·           Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

description_html:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous :

En tant que postdoctorant.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au au Centre Microélectronique de Provence, département Bioélectronique. Au sein de ce service vous vous contribuez à une recherche interdisciplinaire au service de l’innovation scientifique et sociétale.

Entité :

Le Département Bioélectronique du Centre Microélectronique de Provence développe des technologies innovantes à l’interface entre électronique, matériaux et sciences du vivant.
Implanté à Gardanne, au cœur de la région Aix-Marseille, il dispose d’un environnement de recherche de pointe et d’une salle blanche entièrement équipée.
Ses équipes évoluent dans un contexte international et interdisciplinaire, en collaboration étroite avec des partenaires académiques et cliniques.

Objectif stratégique du recrutement :

Renforcer les capacités de recherche du Département Bioélectronique avec un postdoctorant capable de développer une nouvelle génération de capteurs optiques organiques flexibles pour l’imagerie calcique.
Ce recrutement contribuera à faire progresser une technologie à fort potentiel à l’interface entre microélectronique, bioélectronique et neurosciences.

Missions principales :

o   Vous développez et micro-fabriquez des photodétecteurs organiques (OPD) flexibles miniaturisés destinés à la réalisation de matrices multipixels haute résolution.

o   Vous développez une électronique de lecture flexible à base de transistors à effet de champ (FET), permettant l’amplification et la mesure des très faibles photocourants générés par les OPD.

o   Vous étudiez les limites physiques liées à la miniaturisation des photodétecteurs et établissez les règles de conception en analysant notamment le courant d’obscurité, le bruit, la détectivité et la gamme dynamique.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Institut Mines-Télécom
description_html:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.

Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.

Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage.

Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM.

À propos du projet PLEIADES

Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM.

Vos principales missions seront de :

  • Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

  • Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris


Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

Vous bénéficierez de :

  • 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT)

  • flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service)

  • télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible

  • Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75%

  • Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...

  • A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé

Informations diverses :
Date limite de candidature : 30 novembre 2026

Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois
Description de poste ici
Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: FR Solution Sales Manager - Videosurveillance
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Synology - Personio
description_html:
Build a better world with data

We are looking for an experienced Sales Manager to develop our business and channel for our videosurveillance portfolio. This role will report to the Solution Team Manager and will be based in our Paris office with frequent travel to other regions to meet partners, customers and prospects.
The Solution Team regroups technical experts, pre-sales engineers and solution-focused sales.
 
You will be expected to own and grow sales of our entire surveillance portfolio, which includes IP cameras, NVRs (Network Video Recorders), AI analytics solutions (DVA), PoE switches, visualization stations for camera walls, and will soon include access control devices. We offer a fully-featured VMS (Surveillance Station) and Cloud surveillance platform (Surveillance365).
 
The position will focus mostly on the French and Benelux market, but you will also be expected to assist our other regions (Spain, Portugal, Italy, Greece) to develop their surveillance sales.


Your mission

  • Channel Management: Manage an existing network of partners focused on Videoprotection.
  • Channel Development: Develop sales pipelines for our offerings, including recruiting new partners and developing partnerships with other manufacturers.
  • Build Partnerships: Build strong relationships with all our partners in France and Benelux through virtual meetings and physical visits to train them and level-up their knowledge.
  • End user consulting: Work directly with end users to analyze their needs and provide a comprehensive solution with the assistance of the pre-sales team, and work with channel partners to fulfill this need.
  • Project Follow-up: Manage the entire project pipeline with customers, from pre-sales consulting to pricing to deployment recommendations and feedback collection.
  • Prospect New Pipelines: Find and prospect new accounts (channel partners and end customers) to grow sales pipeline.
  • VIP Customer Management: Own the relationship with our top surveillance accounts.
  • Content Management: Own the creation and publication of surveillance-focused content in partnership with the rest of the Solution Team and our Marketing Team.
  • Event Participation: Participate in Synology’s events and webinars, and external activities as a representative for our surveillance solutions.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Analyze sales figures and create strategic plans to grow sales.
  • Other Duties: Perform other duties as assigned.


Your profile

  • Education and Experience: BAC+5 and 5+ years of experience in B2B sales or account management in the videosurveillance industry. Technical experience will also be valued.
  • Market and Channel Knowledge: Familiar with the videosurveillance industry, and especially channels (distributors, resellers, system integrators…)
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong knowledge of videosurveillance products and solutions, ideally including Synology’s offerings.
  • Language Proficiency: Native French and an advanced English level are required.
  • Skills: Autonomy and entrepreneurship mindset, strong presentation skills, organizational abilities, creativity, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects.

title: Comercial de Software B2B | IA y Transformación Digital
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Zvoove
description_html:
El Puesto

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Trabajarás en un entorno B2B tecnológico, con ciclos de venta consultivos y clientes de tamaño medio y grande, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de producto, consultoría, marketing y dirección.

Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Mejorar la prospección y segmentación de cuentas
  • Preparar reuniones y analizar información de clientes
  • Identificar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio
  • Personalizar mensajes y propuestas comerciales
  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline
  • Automatizar tareas comerciales y administrativas
  • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial
  • Formar parte de un equipo técnico y especializado donde tu opinión puede influir tanto en el producto como en la estrategia comercial
  • Oportunidad real de crecimiento profesional en el área comercial y de desarrollo de negocio
  • Entorno donde se valoran la iniciativa, la autonomía, el rigor y la capacidad de aportar
  • Acompañamiento inicial para que puedas conocer nuestro producto, nuestros sectores y nuestra metodología comercial
  • Condiciones competitivas acordes a la experiencia aportada, con fijo + variable por objetivos


Esperamos recibir su solicitud.

Más que un perfil que simplemente "venda software", buscamos a una persona que quiera convertirse en referente comercial de nuestras soluciones. Alguien capaz de sentarse con un cliente, entender cómo funciona su negocio, detectar dónde están sus problemas, explicar cómo puede ayudar la tecnología y construir una propuesta que tenga sentido tanto operativa como económicamente.Y, especialmente, alguien que entienda que la IA no es solo una tecnología más, sino una nueva forma de trabajar, vender y aportar valor a nuestros clientes.Si te motiva vender soluciones tecnológicas complejas, disfrutas entendiendo el negocio del cliente, tienes curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA y te gusta construir relaciones comerciales basadas en confianza, conocimiento y resultados, nos encantará conocerte.Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos brevemente qué proyectos de venta consultiva tecnológica has liderado, qué tipo de soluciones has vendido y cómo estás utilizando actualmente la IA en tu trabajo.

description_html:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for an engaged and passionate Staff Engineer to join our growing engineering department and be a technical leader across our engineering teams.
 
As a Staff Engineer, you will be responsible for driving influence across teams and domains, leading solution delivery on cross-functional and strategic initiatives, and serving as a technical leader within the engineering organization. You will ensure the set quality standards and drive the adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.
 
Quality, excellence, and agility drive our delivery processes and you will help us level these up. Using NodeJS and Typescript back-end stacks, appropriate for each requirement, but always hosted on AWS, we build added value and resilient services on top of voice and fully integrate with our customers’ business critical tools (CRM, Helpdesk, E-Commerce, …).
 

Your mission @ Aircall:
  • Lead transversal, complex projects, fully autonomously from ideation to completion, starting from a high-level problem statement.
  • Proactively communicate the technical vision across multiple teams, ensuring alignment and sharing knowledge across domains.
  • Act as a go-to expert, providing mentorship and guidance across teams.
  • Deeply understand multiple product domains; proactively identify improvements and advocate for customer needs across the company.
  • Lead and define technical strategies for complex, impactful problems.
  • Set and uphold higher quality standards and drive adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.
  • Writes production-ready code, finding appropriate solutions for medium complexity challenges; participates in software design discussions; demonstrates a good understanding of system infrastructure and DevOps principles; contributes to performance and quality within their scope; applies a security-first mindset.
    •

  • A little about you:You have extensive experience (e.g., 10+ years) in back-end development, using TypeScript & NodeJS/Python/Ruby/Rails or other languages, with a focus on delivering for security, scalability, availability, and performance across multiple domains.
  • You lead and define technical strategies, demonstrating a strong understanding of system design to solve complex, impactful problems.
  • You are comfortable leading the development of complex projects affecting multiple teams and domains, driving initiatives from ideation to completion.
  • You are an expert at identifying opportunities for new impactful initiatives.
  • You have a deep understanding of multiple product domains and can anticipate long-term needs.
  • You possess effective and proactive communication skills, and can collaborate with different profiles and roles to ensure cross-domain alignment.

    • Our Tech Stack:
  • You do not need to be familiar with all of our technical stack or any specific functional area, but you have a strong willingness to learn and adapt quickly.
  • Typescript/Node.js, Python, REST API/GraphQL APIs, Ruby/Rails, React AWS/Serverless or EKS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Redis

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Business Partner to serve as the dedicated operational partner to the GM, EMEA. In this role, you'll be the connective tissue between the EMEA go-to-market (GTM) organization and Global Revenue Operations (RevOps), owning the operating cadence, surfacing the insights that drive decisions, and turning regional strategy into executable plans.

You'll support the full EMEA GTM motion across Business Development Representative (BDR), Account Executive (AE), Partner Account Manager (PAM), Account Manager (AM), Solutions Engineer (SE), Customer Engineer (CE), and Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) functions, spanning four Areas: FIME, UKI, DACH, and Iberia. You'll run the forecast and QBR cadence, own analytics and insights for the region, drive process improvement, and feed regional learnings back into the Global RevOps Center of Excellence, so best practices scale across the business.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who can move fluently between the boardroom and the spreadsheet — equally comfortable facilitating an executive forecast review and building the capacity model underneath it.


What you will do:

  • Act as the trusted operational partner to the GM, EMEA, owning the region's GTM operating model and rhythm of business

  • Run the EMEA forecast process end to end — preparing, facilitating, and following up on weekly forecast calls across the four Areas (FIME, UKI, DACH, Iberia)

  • Own the quarterly business review (QBR) cadence: structure, narrative, data, and readouts for regional and executive audiences

title: Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Loftorbital
description_html:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture.

The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale.

In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit.


About this role:
  • Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
  • Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
  • Design and implement unit and integration tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.
  • Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
  • Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
  • Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
  • Coordinate with downstream teams on the distribution and adoption of the latest releases.
  • In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Must Haves:
  • 3+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python.
  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with continuous integration tools (GitLab-CI, Jenkins, or similar).
  • Knowledge of build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).
  • Understanding of distributed architecture.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP, TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.
  • Experience in developing multi-threaded applications.
  • Previous team leader or manager role

Nice to Haves:
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust.
  • Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms.
  • Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)
  • Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ/NATS, etc.)
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S, systemd-nspawn)
  • Experience with space systems and concepts

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together

description_html:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our core products. This is responsible for monitoring and control of major space program elements, including:

  • Flight Products computational environments (including physical and virtual processors);

  • Interfaces with external equipment (imagers, RF, ISL); and

  • Interfaces with the spacecraft bus.

Hyperdrive is the common platform powering every onboard service across our spacecraft.
The team builds the core capabilities other onboard services need to run mission logic—from interactions and housekeeping to events, automated fault detection and recovery, and lifecycle management.
By making complex spacecraft software consistent, observable, and resilient, Hyperdrive helps teams move faster while keeping missions safe in orbit.

 

About this role:
  • Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
  • Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
  • Design and implement unit tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.
  • Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
  • Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
  • Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
  • Coordinate with downstream teams on the release, distribution and adoption of latest releases.
  • In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Must Haves:
  • 5+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with continuous integration tools (e.g., GitLab-CI, Jenkins).
  • Experience with build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).
  • Experience with library management and ABI/API version control.
  • Understanding of distributed architecture.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP, TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.
  • Experience in developing multi-threaded applications.

Nice to Haves:
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust.
  • Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms.
  • Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)
  • Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ/NATS, etc.)
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S, systemd-nspawn)

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable

title: Client Enablement & Coaching Lead
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kraken
description_html:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

  • Fluent English & French is a prerequisite

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

Please submit your resume in English 🇬🇧

This position involves travelling across different European countries 🚃

You may see this role listed as "Client Enablement and Coaching Lead". This is to help the right people find it. The actual job title is Client Delivery Lead.

Grâce à une suite complète de solutions SaaS combinant gestion de flux produits, gestion des marketplaces, veille tarifaire concurrentielle et monitoring des réseaux de distribution, Lengow permet aux marques et aux retailers d’accroître la visibilité de leurs produits, d’affiner leur stratégie tarifaire, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de mieux piloter leur réseau de distribution.

Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne plus de 3 600 marques et revendeurs dans plus de 70 pays.

Rejoindre Lengow, c’est aussi évoluer dans un environnement international et multiculturel, au contact d’équipes aux profils variés, réparties notamment entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone.

À propos de l’équipe IT interne

L’équipe IT interne de Lengow veille au bon fonctionnement et à la sécurité de l’environnement de travail de nos 150 collaborateurs répartis entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone.

Elle est composée d’un(e) IT Manager, responsable de l’ensemble du périmètre IT interne, accompagné(e) d’un(e) alternant(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux.

Notre environnement couvre notamment le support utilisateurs, la gestion du parc informatique, les systèmes et réseaux, la gestion des comptes et des accès, la sécurité et l’administration de nos outils internes.

L’équipe intervient dans un environnement multi-sites et multi-OS (Windows, macOS et Linux) et travaille à la fois sur les opérations IT du quotidien et sur des projets d’amélioration et de modernisation de notre environnement.

Objectif du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe IT et travailler au quotidien aux côtés de l’IT Manager.

Cette alternance te permettra de développer une expérience concrète et polyvalente de l’IT interne, aux côtés de l’IT Manager. Tu monteras progressivement en compétences sur un périmètre IT varié, avec de plus en plus d’autonomie et de responsabilités, aussi bien sur les opérations du quotidien que sur des projets d’amélioration. 

Tu évolueras dans un environnement international, avec des collaborateurs présents sur plusieurs sites, à accompagner aussi bien sur place qu’à distance.

⌨️ Tes principales missions

Support utilisateurs

  • Assurer le support IT des collaborateurs sur site et à distance
  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents liés aux postes, outils et accès
  • Préparer et accompagner les arrivées et départs des collaborateurs
  • Escalader les problématiques complexes à l’IT Manager lorsque nécessaire

Parc informatique

  • Préparer, configurer et maintenir les équipements utilisateurs
  • Participer au suivi du parc et à la gestion de l’inventaire IT
  • Intervenir sur des environnements Windows, macOS et Linux
  • Participer au renouvellement et au déploiement des équipements

Systèmes, accès & réseaux

  • Participer à l’administration de Google Workspace et Active Directory
  • Contribuer à la gestion des comptes, groupes et droits utilisateurs
  • Participer au maintien et au dépannage du réseau : Wi-Fi, VLAN, switches et connectivité
  • Contribuer au maintien en condition opérationnelle de l’environnement IT

Sécurité & amélioration continue

  • Contribuer au déploiement des mises à jour et outils de sécurité
  • Participer au suivi de la sécurité des postes de travail
  • Contribuer à la documentation des procédures et de l’environnement IT
  • Participer à l’amélioration et à l’automatisation des processus IT
  • Accompagner l’IT Manager sur différents projets d’évolution de l’environnement

Requirements

🏹 Profil recherché

Connaissances :

  • Bases solides en réseau (TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLAN)
  • Connaissances initiales en administration de systèmes Windows et/ou Linux ; une première exposition à Active Directory est appréciée
  • Sensibilisation aux bonnes pratiques de sécurité informatique
  • Français courant et bon niveau d’anglais professionnel (B2 minimum)

Qualités personnelles :

  • Curiosité, rigueur et envie d’apprendre
  • Bon relationnel et sens du service
  • Bonnes aptitudes en résolution de problèmes
  • Esprit d’équipe et capacité à collaborer

Une première expérience en support ou administration systèmes et réseaux est appréciée, mais nous recherchons avant tout une personne avec de bonnes bases techniques et l’envie de progresser sur un périmètre IT varié.

🪜 Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien RH en visio
  • Entretien manager
  • Test technique suivi d’un débrief

Benefits

✨ Rejoindre Lengow, c’est aussi bénéficier de nombreux avantages :

🏖️ 5 semaines de congés payés
🏡 Horaires flexibles, 2 jours de télétravail par semaine et indemnité télétravail
🍴 Tickets restaurant (EdenRed) : 8 €/jour, pris en charge à 50 % par Lengow
🚲 Indemnité mobilité douce jusqu’à 200 €/an ou remboursement des transports en commun à 50 %
💻 Choix de ton environnement de travail : MacOS, Windows ou Linux
🩺 Mutuelle & prévoyance Malakoff Humanis
🍎 Fruits frais livrés au bureau chaque semaine
🎉 Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour se retrouver et partager des moments ensemble
